                    Which Newly Commissioned Works Does Ho Tzu Nyen Present in the Exhibition?
                    Hyundai Translocal Series: Ho Tzu Nyen presents newly commissioned, site-specific works by Singapore-based artist Ho Tzu Nyen, whose work across film, video, performance, and multimedia installation investigates the plurality of cultural identities across Southeast Asia. Drawing on numerous Eastern and Western cultural references, Ho’s works blend mythical narratives and historical facts to mobilize different understandings of history, its writing, and its transmission.Commissioned for the New Museum, P for Power: Up Down (2026) is installed on screens in the museum’s OMA-designed, glass-front elevators looking onto the Bowery. When an elevator button is activated, a life-size child protagonist appears on screen and delivers a short text in the form of a mantra, question, riddle, or note reflecting on the nature of power.Each time a visitor presses a floor button, an AI system generates a new image sequence in real time. Here, AI functions not simply as a tool for producing images, but as a generative structure through which narratives and identities remain open to change.Presented in parallel with Ho’s commission for the Ulsan Art Museum, the exhibition connects New York and Ulsan through a shared conceptual framework while responding to the distinct architectural and cultural contexts of each site.Following the New York presentation, P for Power: Double Life of P (2026) will open at the Ulsan Art Museum on October 22. Configured as an immersive installation using 24 projectors and a multichannel sound system, P for Power: Double Life of P (2026) incorporates data drawn from Ulsan’s industries, technologies, materials, and soundscapes. Together, the mutable nature of the two works connects to Ho’s longstanding engagement with histories and identities that resist singular or fixed definition. Across New York and Ulsan, the exhibition explores the multiple meanings of power, from political and technological systems to more fluid notions of endurance, transformation, and agency.
                    We are thrilled to inaugurate our partnership with an exciting new commission by the exceptional artist Ho Tzu Nyen exploring notions of power in the context of our two museums and our two cities.
	                    Massimiliano Gioni
	                         Toby Devan Lewis Director of the New Museum, and Changsub Lim, Director of the Ulsan Art Museum
                    We are delighted to present Hyundai Translocal Series: Ho Tzu Nyen, situating the artist’s ongoing exploration within the distinctive contexts of New York and Ulsan. Through institutional collaboration and translocal exchange, this exhibition fosters a dialogue on relationality and the contemporary narratives that unfold across place.
	                    DooEun Choi
	                         Art Director of Hyundai Motor Company

                    How Does the Collaboration Connect New York and Ulsan?
                    Beginning with Hyundai Translocal Series: Ho Tzu Nyen, the New Museum and the Ulsan Art Museum will collaborate on a three-year exhibition program through 2028, with two additional commissions to follow.Through this collaboration, New York and Ulsan become interconnected sites of translation and transformation, where artistic ideas take on new meanings across translocal contexts.By presenting site-specific works on the New Museum's elevator screens and at the Ulsan Art Museum's XR Lab — an experimental space dedicated to media art — the collaboration creates an ongoing dialogue between the two cities while exploring how contemporary issues intersect with broader global currents.Hyundai Translocal Series: Ho Tzu Nyen is co-curated by:Massimiliano Gioni, Toby Devan Lewis Director, New MuseumGary Carrion-Murayari, Kraus Family Senior Curator, New MuseumTaeyi Kim, Curatorial Fellow, New MuseumChangsub Lim, Director, Ulsan Art MuseumKyungah Kweon, Curator, Ulsan Art Museum

                Kyeongjin Kimkyeongjin.kim@hyundai.comGlobal PR Team · Hyundai Motor CompanyDisclaimer: Hyundai Motor Company believes the information contained herein to be accurate at the time of release. However, the company may upload new or updated information if required and assumes that it is not liable for the accuracy of any information interpreted and used by the reader.About Ho Tzu NyenHo Tzu Nyen (b. 1976, Singapore) is a Singapore-based artist and filmmaker. Working across film, video, performance, and multimedia installation, he investigates the plurality of cultural identities across Southeast Asia. Ho has held solo exhibitions at LUMA Arles (2025); Mudam, Luxembourg (2025); Hessel Museum, Annandale-on-Hudson (2024); Museum of Contemporary Art Tokyo (2024); Singapore Art Museum (2023); and Hammer Museum, Los Angeles (2022). His works are held in the collections of the Metropolitan Museum of Art, New York; Tate Modern, London; Guggenheim, New York and Abu Dhabi; M+ Museum, Hong Kong; MMCA, Seoul; Mori Art Museum, Tokyo; and Singapore Art Museum, among others. He is the Artistic Director of the 16th Gwangju Biennale (2026).About New MuseumThe New Museum is the only museum in New York City exclusively devoted to contemporary art. Founded in 1977, the New Museum is a center for exhibitions, information, and documentation about living artists from around the world. From its beginnings as a one-room office on Hudson Street, to the inauguration of its SANAA-designed flagship building in 2007, to the OMA-designed expansion of its home on the Bowery in 2026, the New Museum continues to be a place of experimentation and a hub of new art and new ideas.About Ulsan Art MuseumOpened in January 2022, Ulsan Art Museum is the city's first public art museum, established in response to the long-standing cultural aspirations of its residents. Envisioned as a future-oriented museum grounded in digital technology, it serves as an open platform for experimental and innovative artistic discourse. Since its opening, the museum has presented exhibitions that cross the boundaries of traditional media—including painting, sculpture, new media, and installation—while engaging with key contemporary themes such as artificial intelligence, ecology, technology, and migration. Beyond its galleries, the museum offers a diverse artistic environment through facilities such as the XR Lab, a dedicated immersive space for media art; a research library providing specialized art publications and visual resources; and a multipurpose hall that hosts academic programs and interdisciplinary projects.About Hyundai Motor’s Art ProjectsFor over a decade, Hyundai Motor Company has deepened its partnerships with museums and cultural organizations worldwide, including Tate, the Los Angeles County Museum of Art (LACMA), the Whitney Museum of American Art, and the Korean Pavilion at the Venice Biennale. Hyundai Translocal Series is a new partnership initiative that roots itself in fostering dialogues and collaborations among art institutions in Korea and across the globe. Hyundai Motor’s own art initiatives include open call programs such as the VH AWARD, the Hyundai Blue Prize+, and Artlab Editorial, a digital platform dedicated to art writing by transnational voices. These ongoing collaborations embrace the complexities of the cultural landscape by exploring new ideas and perspectives within and beyond the art ecosystem.For further information, visit artlab.hyundai.com or follow @hyundai.artlab, #HyundaiArtlabAbout Hyundai Motor CompanyEstablished in 1967, Hyundai Motor Company is present in over 200 countries with more than 120,000 employees dedicated to tackling real-world mobility challenges around the globe. Based on the brand vision of ‘Progress for Humanity,’ Hyundai Motor is accelerating its transformation beyond mobility through advanced robotics and physical AI. The company invests in new technologies to bring about revolutionary solutions while pursuing open innovation to introduce future mobility services. In pursuit of a sustainable future for the world, Hyundai Motor will continue its commitment to carbon reduction as a full lineup provider with industry-leading ICE, hybrid, plug-in hybrid, hydrogen fuel cell and EV technologies.More information about Hyundai Motor and its products can be found at:https://www.hyundai.com/worldwide/en/ or Newsroom: Media Hub by HyundaiFollow our Hyundai Global Newsroom Instagram channel @hyundai_mediahub

The new BMW iX4
documents.raw_text:
Mike Reichelt, Head of Neue Klasse, BMW Compact and Midsize
      Class, explains: “With the new fully electric BMW iX4, we
    are expanding the Neue Klasse portfolio with a particularly
    emotional vehicle. Its striking proportions, elegant coupé
    silhouette and Neue Klasse technologies combine to create a truly
    distinctive character. Blending sportiness, expressive design and
    innovative technology, the BMW iX4 sets a bold new accent within our
    fully electric BMW portfolio.”
  Two drive system variants of the BMW iX4 will be available at
    launch in March 2027. These will be followed shortly afterwards by
    the range-topping model, the extremely powerful BMW iX4 M60 xDrive.
    Like all the BMW iX4 variants, the flagship model has one electric
    motor at the front axle and one at the rear. In the BMW iX4 M60
    xDrive they team up to produce maximum output of 450 kW/612 hp1
    and 875 Nm (645 lb-ft) of torque1.
     Elegantly sporting silhouette, distinctive rear-end design.
    The sporty roofline of the BMW iX4 links up with its long
    wheelbase and short overhangs to create its coupé-like silhouette.
    The front end displays the eye-catching Neue Klasse face. The BMW
    kidneys and twin headlights – both design icons – merge into a
    single graphic unit. Together, they serve up an interplay of
    geometry and light. Elements of the new BMW M design language shape
    the front end of the flagship BMW iX4 M60 xDrive, while the
    racing-car-inspired M Yellow Lights maximise the car’s visual presence.
    The distinctive rear-end design provides the new BMW iX4 with an
      extrovert identifying feature. Precise lines and clearly sculpted
      surfaces accentuate the expressive character of the SUV coupé. The
      pronounced rear spoiler with integral brake light enhances
      aerodynamics and exudes sporting potency. The BMW iX4 M60 xDrive
      comes with a special M rear spoiler.
    Slim,  horizontally arranged rear lights give the new BMW iX4 an
      aura of poise and assurance. With two light elements on either
      side, they form an abstract take on the L shape familiar from
      previous BMW lights and integrate seamlessly into the tailgate.
      Together, the distinctive, reduced rear light signature and black
      diffuser accentuate the muscular rear looks of the new BMW iX4 M60 xDrive.
       M Sport package included as standard.
      Alongside its special design elements, the standard M Sport
      package for the new BMW iX4 features 20-inch M light-alloy wheels
      and M Sport brakes with blue callipers. Standard specification for
      the BMW iX4 M60 xDrive includes 21-inch light-alloy wheels. Added
      to which, all  BMW  iX4 models can be ordered as an option with
      light-alloy wheels up to 22 inches in size; one of these rim
      variants is reserved exclusively for the M Performance model.
       BMW Iconic Glow exterior package with adaptive light functions.
      The BMW Iconic Glow exterior package includes adaptive light
      functions – such as BMW Selective Beam non-dazzling high-beam
      assistant  and  Adaptive Headlights – which enhance both safety
      and comfort. The BMW Iconic Glow exterior package is part of
      standard specification for the new BMW iX4 M60 xDrive and
      available as an option for all other model variants.
    The BMW iX4 M60 xDrive also comes with black BMW kidney M
      Shadowline trim. This is joined by distinctive light signatures at
      the front and rear, ensuring that the car cuts an unmistakable
      figure in the hours of darkness too.
    Another design highlight of the new BMW iX4 is the large-surface
      panoramic sunroof with climate comfort glazing, which is part of
      standard specification and bathes the interior in light. When the
      order books open, customers can choose from an initial selection
      of nine exterior colour shades for their BMW iX4. These will be
      joined from March 2027 by another trio of Frozen paint finishes
      and later on by numerous additional colours from the BMW
      Individual range.
       Light-flooded interior with generous levels of space.
      The interior of the new BMW iX4 gives customers a
      particularly vivid introduction to the reduced Neue Klasse design.
      The instrument panel makes a particularly sporty and elegant
      statement with its clear lines and high-quality materials.
    The interior is bathed in light thanks to the large window
      surfaces and panoramic sunroof. The new BMW iX4 utilises the
      benefits of the Neue Klasse vehicle architecture, which was
      purpose-developed for electric models and offers generous levels
      of space. This includes excellent legroom and ample headroom, both
      of which are accommodated neatly by the elegant roofline of the
      SUV coupé.
    Customers can choose from seven different interiors. These
      feature a precisely coordinated combination of materials and
      colours and emphasise the character of the new BMW iX4 to stunning
      effect.
       Driver orientation elevated to a new level.
      The new BMW iX4 offers a whole new experience of BMW-typical
      driver orientation, ensuring the driver is always given the right
      information in the right place at the right time.
    BMW Panoramic iDrive with BMW Operating System X creates an
      all-encompassing display and operating system bringing together
      four central elements: the BMW Panoramic Vision, BMW 3D Head-Up
      Display, 17.9-inch Central Display and standard-fit sports
      steering wheel with a central spoke in its upper section and
      shy-tech controls. Standard equipment for the BMW iX4 M60 xDrive
      includes the M Sport  steering wheel in a version specific to this
      model. Setting it apart from the steering wheel available as an
      option for all other BMW iX4 models are features such as a marker
       in the 12 o’clock position and shift paddles.
    The My Modes offer customers a multitude of ways to customise
      their car’s sound, light, displays and drive system. BMW Digital
      Premium brings various M-specific in-car apps to all variants of
      the BMW iX4. These provide access to driving dynamics data,
      technical vehicle signals and additional media content.
    The BMW iX4 M60 xDrive has M-specific displays, including the
      Powermeter, which shows information such as the power currently
      being deployed and the reserves still available.
       BMW iX4 M60 xDrive with M Sport seats as standard.
      The BMW iX4 M60 xDrive has M Sport seats with ten-way
      electric adjustment  as standard. The M Sport seats can also be
      ordered as an option for the other model variants, as can the
      multifunction seats.
    The elegantly sporty seats fitted as standard in the new BMW iX4
      offer excellent comfort and secure lateral support. They come with
      electric adjustment, a memory function and the Travel &
      Comfort System. The rear seat backrest of the BMW iX4 splits
      40:20:40. Seat heating can be specified for the rear seats as an option.
    The new BMW iX4 is fitted as standard with a hi-fi system with
      seven speakers and a system output of 205 watts. The BMW iX4 M60
      xDrive has the Harman Kardon hi-fi system with 13 speakers and 430
      watts as standard. It enables use of Dolby Atmos and can be
      ordered as an option for all other models.
       New BMW iX4 launches with two drive system variants.
      The fundamentally new sixth-generation (Gen6) BMW  eDrive
       technology is a standout innovation of the Neue Klasse and a
      defining component of the new BMW iX4.
    Playing an essential role in this technological leap forward are
      all-new high-voltage batteries with cylindrical cells, 800V
      technology and further developed, highly efficient electric
      motors. Gen6 brings the BMW iX4 even more dynamic performance, up
      to 400 kW DC charging, significantly higher range figures than
      models with Gen5 and bidirectional charging functionality.
    Two drive system variants will initially be available for the new
      BMW iX4 from the start of orders. The BMW iX4 50 xDrive has one
      electric motor at the front axle and one at the rear axle, which
      work together to generate maximum output of 345 kW/469 hp and peak
      torque of 645 Nm (475 lb-ft). The sporty SUV coupé accelerates
      from 0 to 100 km/h (62 mph) in 4.9 seconds and reaches a top speed
      of 210 km/h (130 mph). Its high-voltage battery has a usable
      energy content of 108.7 kWh.
    It offers an outstanding range of up to 828 kilometres (514
      miles)2. The maximum charging rate of the new BMW iX4
      50 xDrive is 400 kW, which means enough energy can be added in ten
      minutes of charging for another 387 kilometres (240 miles) of range3.
    The BMW iX4 40 xDrive also has one electric motor on each axle.
      Together, they produce maximum output of 275 kW/374 hp and peak
      torque of 520 Nm (383 lb-ft). The BMW iX4 40 xDrive needs 5.6
      seconds for the sprint from rest to 100 km/h (62 mph). Its maximum
      range is 638 kilometres (396 miles)2.
       Setting new standards: the BMW iX4 M60 xDrive.
      Shortly after the order books open for its two sister models,
      the range-topping BMW iX4 M60 xDrive will join the line-up: it can
      be ordered from January 2027. The M Performance model has an
      M-specific all-wheel-drive application and serves up
      smile-inducing performance. Developing 450 kW/612 hp4,
      this is the most powerful version of the new BMW iX4 and sprints
      from 0 to 100 km/h (62 mph) in 3.9 seconds4. The
      electronically limited top speed of the BMW iX4 M60 xDrive is 240
      km/h (149 mph)4. The M Performance model has a maximum
      range of up to 777 kilometres (483 miles)4.
       Heart of Joy brings a new dimension in driving pleasure.
      The new BMW iX4 utilises previously untapped potential of
      electric mobility. Like all Neue Klasse models, this
      software-defined car has a newly developed electronics and
      software architecture. The Heart of Joy high-performance computer
      links up with the BMW Dynamic Performance Control Driving Stack to
      provide hugely effective drive system and driving dynamics
      control. The Heart of Joy works ten times faster than previous
      systems and reduces the number of control inputs required. This
      technological leap forward ensures extremely effortless, precise
      and composed driving characteristics.
         Adaptive M suspension: turning up the dial for
          sportiness and comfort.
        The new, flat high-voltage battery is the key to the
        extremely low centre of  gravity  of  the new BMW iX4. Together
        with the almost perfectly balanced weight distribution and
        upgraded chassis technology, this paves the way for precise and
        agile handling. In addition, the long wheelbase provides
        outstanding directional stability.
      Leading the way dynamically in the BMW iX4 line-up is the BMW
        iX4 M60 xDrive, which comes as standard with adaptive M
        suspension. This brings electronically controlled shock
        absorbers and sport steering with variable rack-and-pinion ratio
        – and enhances both sportiness and comfort. Adaptive M
        suspension is available as an option for all BMW iX4 models. The
        BMW iX4 M60 xDrive comes exclusively with an electronically
        controlled M locking differential at the rear axle. It also
        offers two M-exclusive My Modes – M Sport and M Sport Plus –
        that provide a particularly engaging and sporty driving experience.
         Innovative assistance systems and active safety functions.
        The new BMW iX4 is offered with an extensive array of
        standard and optional assistance systems. The application of
        advanced technology and increased use of artificial
        intelligence  provide even greater safety and genuinely reduce
        the strain on the driver during partially automated driving and
        parking . BMW Symbiotic Drive ensures intuitive interaction
        between human behaviour and driver assistance. The Motorway
        Assistant enables hands-free driving up to 130 km/h (81
        mph)5 in numerous countries and intelligently
        assisted lane changes  on approved routes.
    *All of the equipment features, fuel/electric power consumption
      and CO₂ figures in this media information refer to the German
      market. These may vary in other markets.
     1 All figures are provisional. Please note: Since no
    binding WLTP values are currently available, these are provisional
    values. In addition, the actual values depend on various factors,
    such as load, driving style, route, weather, auxiliary consumers
    (including climate control), tyres and battery condition.
      2The figures stated were determined based on the
      prescribed WLTP measurement procedure. The real-world values
      depend on various factors, such as load, driving style, route,
      weather, auxiliary consumers (including climate control systems),
      tyres and battery condition.
      3The added range after ten minutes of high-power
      charging was determined in accordance with ISO 12906 in the WLTP
      cycle and assumes that the charging infrastructure enables the
      maximum DC charging power. The actual range added and charging
      performance depend on the vehicle equipment, state of
      charge/condition of the battery, ambient/battery temperature,
      driving profile, auxiliary consumers, vehicle-specific charging
      settings and the charging power provided at the charging station.
      4All figures are provisional. Please note: Since no
      binding WLTP values are currently available, these are provisional
      values. In addition, the actual values depend on various factors,
      such as load, driving style, route, weather, auxiliary consumers
      (including climate control), tyres and battery condition. All
      information is provisional.
      5By the end of 2026 in Germany, United Kingdom,
      Ireland, Belgium, Netherlands, Luxembourg, France, Spain,
      Portugal, Italy, Switzerland, Liechtenstein, Austria, Czechia,
      Poland, Denmark, Sweden, Norway, USA, Canada and Japan.

documents.title: BMW Motorrad Presents the New BMW F 450 R.
documents.raw_text:
Munich. “The BMW F 450 R has everything that defines a true
    BMW naked bike: performance, precision, and pure riding pleasure. It
    is light, agile, and full of character. We have developed a
    motorcycle that inspires confidence from the outset while also
    generating a lot of excitement. With the F 450 R, we are bringing
    our decades-long naked bike tradition into a compact and especially
    accessible format.”
  Markus Flasch, CEO BMW Motorrad
  The new BMW F 450 R: A dynamic naked bike for the 48-hp
    class—developed for maximum riding pleasure and featuring iconic BMW
    design language.
  The new BMW F 450 R for the 48-hp class was developed as a
  standalone naked bike within the BMW F 450 model family. The focus was
  on signature BMW riding pleasure, enabled by a carefully engineered
  chassis and geometry layout, rigorous weight optimization, and a
  powerful parallel-twin engine. Its design clearly follows the current
  design language of the high-performance S 1000 R naked bike and
  visually underscores its sporty ambitions.
  Smooth and characterful parallel-twin engine with a 135-degree
    crankpin offset for dynamic riding pleasure.
  At the heart of the new BMW F 450 R is the newly developed
  fuel-injected parallel-twin engine first used in the F 450 GS,
  together with a stainless-steel underfloor muffler. For use in the F
  450 R, it has been specifically tuned for road riding and gives the
  motorcycle a particularly distinctive sound. With an output of 35 kW
  (48 hp) at 8,750 rpm and maximum torque of 43 Nm at 6,750 rpm, the new
  F 450 R delivers powerful acceleration and confident roll-on
  performance. As much as 80 percent of the available torque is already
  on tap at 3,000 rpm, providing strong propulsion from low engine
  speeds. High-tech materials and optimized internal friction make these
  performance figures possible from exactly 420 cc. This makes the
  engine one of the most compact and powerful units in the A2
  parallel-twin segment. It not only meets the stringent Euro 5+
  requirements, but is also particularly efficient, with fuel
  consumption of just 3.8 liters per 100 km. With its 14-liter fuel
  tank, the F 450 R achieves a range of more than 350 km. The service
  interval is the BMW Motorrad-standard 10,000 km.
  Easy Ride Clutch (ERC) for a significant increase in operating
    and riding comfort.
  The optional Easy Ride Clutch (ERC) engages the clutch
  according to engine speed, increasing comfort and control—especially
  in urban traffic, while maneuvering, and on winding country roads. In
  combination with Shift Assistant Pro, it enables riding and shifting
  without manual clutch operation; the clutch lever remains available
  for deliberate rider input.
  Six-speed transmission and left-side secondary drive. Shift
    Assistant Pro for fast upshifts and downshifts without operating the
      clutch.
  The six-speed transmission transfers torque to the left-side
  secondary drive via an X-ring chain. For rapid upshifts and downshifts
  without operating the clutch, the new F 450 R is equipped with Shift
  Assistant Pro in every equipment variant except the base model. It can
  be retrofitted to the base model.
  ABS Pro, DBC, DTC, and MSR, plus the “Rain,” “Road,” and
    “Dynamic” riding modes as standard—delivering a high level of riding
    pleasure and safety.
  The standard “Rain,” “Road,” and “Dynamic” riding modes allow
  riders to tailor the new BMW F 450 R to their individual preferences.
  ABS Pro, Dynamic Brake Control (DBC), Dynamic Traction Control (DTC),
  and engine drag torque control (MSR) are also standard.
  Chassis with a tubular steel space frame for high rigidity,
    robustness, and riding precision. Naked bike-specific tuning and a
    short wheelbase for agile, playful turn-in behavior.
  The new BMW F 450 R also uses the newly developed BMW F 450
  GS chassis concept as its technical foundation, with a setup tailored
  specifically to road use. The tuning focused on easy handling,
  excellent accessibility, and direct feedback. The tubular frame is
  made of welded steel tubes and forged components, with the
  parallel-twin engine integrated as a load-bearing element.
  Front wheel control via KYB upside-down telescopic fork and
    rear wheel control via an aluminum hollow-cast double-sided swingarm
    with a KYB central spring strut.
  At the front, a torsionally rigid 43 mm KYB upside-down
  telescopic fork controls the wheel. On the so-called “Sport
  Suspension,” the fork offers adjustable rebound and compression damping.
At the rear, the wheel is guided by a closed, highly
  torsion-resistant yet lightweight hollow-cast aluminum double-sided
  swingarm. It is paired with a directly mounted KYB central spring
  strut with adjustable spring preload and rebound damping.
  Wheels and tires designed for dynamic riding pleasure.
  The new BMW F 450 R rides on lightweight yet robust
  cast-aluminum wheels. The naked bike is fitted with
  tubeless tires measuring 110/70-17 at the front and 150/60-17 at the rear.
  Powerful braking system combined with BMW Motorrad ABS Pro for
    safe braking, even when leaned over. Dynamic Brake Control (DBC) and
    the dynamic brake light provide additional safety features.
  At the front wheel of the new BMW F 450 R, a floating
  single-disc brake with a Brembo four-piston monobloc fixed caliper and
  a 310 mm brake disc provides confident and efficient deceleration. At
  the rear, a single-disc brake with a floating ByBre single-piston
  caliper and a 240 mm disc is used.
BMW Motorrad ABS Pro is standard on the new BMW F 450 R. The system
  enables ABS-assisted braking when leaned over, increasing safety in
  corners. Dynamic Brake Control (DBC) enhances safety during braking in
  challenging situations by preventing unintended throttle application.
  The dynamic brake light effectively alerts following vehicles that the
  motorcycle ahead is slowing down.
  Optimal ergonomics and equipment for comfortable, playfully
    agile riding enjoyment on the road.
  A carefully engineered ergonomic triangle and a tapered
  aluminum handlebar positioned high and close to the rider provide an
  ideal riding position in all conditions. The bodywork and the 14-liter
  fuel tank beneath it are shaped for secure support and effective knee grip.
The new BMW F 450 R comes standard with a two-piece seat at a height
  of 790 mm, offering most riders an ideal balance of comfort and
  performance. Ergonomics can be customized with Original BMW Motorrad
  Accessories: the high Sport rider’s seat raises the seating position
  by 20 mm, while the low rider’s seat lowers it by 15 mm. The gearshift
  lever, footbrake lever, and side stand are made of forged aluminum.
  The passenger footpeg brackets are bolted to the rear frame—an
  exceptional feature in this vehicle class.
  Reversible shift pattern for an extra dose of sportiness and a
    true racing feel.
  For an extra dose of sportiness, the shift pattern can be
  reversed quickly and with minimal effort—ideal for occasional track outings.
  Powerful LED headlight and LED lighting as standard.
    Connectivity with comprehensive information and functionality
    through a large, perfectly legible 6.5-inch TFT display. Practical
    USB-C port in the cockpit area.
  The new BMW F 450 R comes standard with an LED headlight
  featuring bracket-shaped daytime running light LEDs. The turn
  indicators and taillight of the new F 450 R also use LED technology.
The standard 6.5-inch TFT display on the new BMW F 450 R offers a
  wide range of information, brilliant display quality, and intuitive
  operation at a premium level. The TFT display features the Pure Ride
  Screen. M Sport variants with Riding Modes Pro also offer three
  additional Sport screens with detailed information on DTC, braking
  force, and lean angle, as well as a lap timer function. Riders can
  also make phone calls, listen to music, and navigate conveniently
  while riding.
  Four attractive equipment variants for the new BMW F 450 R.
  The new BMW F 450 R is available in four equipment variants.
The BMW F 450 R Base is finished in Cosmic Black.
  Also finished in Cosmic Black, the BMW F 450 R
  Exclusive additionally features Shift Assistant Pro and Sport
  suspension. The range-topping models are the BMW F 450 R
  M Sport and the
  BMW F 450 R M Sport with Innovation Package
  (including Easy Ride Clutch), in Snaefell white / M Motorsport,
  including Riding Modes Pro, Shift Assistant Pro, and the Sport
  Suspension. Their white frame and rim stickers in M Motorsport colors
  create distinctive visual accents.
  Highlights of the new BMW F 450 R:
  Development focus: maximum riding pleasure through excellent
    handling, strong performance, rigorous weight optimization, and
    optimal accessibility.
  Outstanding power-to-weight ratio in the A2 class: 48 hp with a
    ready-to-ride weight of just 175 kg.
  Parallel-twin engine producing 35 kW (48 hp) at 8,750 rpm and
    maximum torque of 43 Nm at 6,750 rpm.
  Lightweight, characterful engine with excellent smoothness thanks
    to a balance shaft and 135-degree crankpin offset, combined with a
    rigorous lightweight design.
  Four attractive equipment variants:
        BMW F 450 R Base.
        BMW F 450 R Exclusive (including Shift
        Assistant Pro and Sport suspension).
        BMW F 450 R M Sport (including Riding Modes
        Pro, Shift Assistant Pro, and Sport suspension).
        BMW F 450 R M Sport with Innovation Package
        (including ERC, Riding Modes Pro, Shift
        Assistant Pro, and Sport suspension).
  Easy Ride Clutch (ERC) for a significant increase in ease of use,
    riding comfort, and performance: available ex-factory for M Sport as
    part of the Innovation Package; retrofittable to all other variants
    as an Original BMW Motorrad Accessory.
  Six-speed transmission and left-side secondary drive. Shift
    Assistant Pro for fast upshifts and downshifts without operating the clutch.
  Stainless-steel underfloor exhaust system with two catalytic converters.
  “Rain,” “Road,” and “Dynamic” riding modes, plus ABS Pro, DBC,
    DTC, and MSR, are standard for a high level of riding pleasure and
    safety. Riding Modes Pro adds the individually configurable “Dynamic
    Pro” riding mode.
  Chassis with a tubular steel space frame for optimal rigidity,
    robustness, and riding precision. Naked bike-specific tuning, a
    short wheelbase, and compact packaging.
  Front wheel control via an upside-down telescopic fork and rear
    wheel control via an aluminum hollow-cast double-sided swingarm with
    a central spring strut; spring preload and rebound damping are adjustable.
  Powerful Brembo braking system combined with BMW Motorrad ABS Pro
    for safe braking, even when leaned over. Dynamic Brake Control (DBC)
    and a dynamic brake light provide additional safety features.
  Forged-aluminum foot controls and side stand for optimized weight.
  Passenger footpeg brackets bolted to the rear frame.
  Reversible shift pattern for occasional track outings.
  Heated grips as standard.
  Powerful LED headlight and LED lighting as standard.
  Connectivity with extensive capabilities and exemplary
    functionality through a large, perfectly legible 6.5-inch TFT display.
  Practical USB-C port in the cockpit area.
  Tailored Original BMW Motorrad Accessories in premium quality—from
    storage and design to M Performance Parts, safety, ergonomics and
    comfort, maintenance and technology, navigation, and communication.
  FAQ / Quick Facts
  Frequently Asked Questions about the BMW F 450 R
  What is the BMW F 450 R?
  The BMW F 450 R is a new lightweight naked bike for the A2
  licence class, with an output of 35 kW (48 hp) and a road-ready weight
  of 175 kg.
  How much power does the BMW F 450 R deliver?
  The two-cylinder in-line engine delivers 35 kW (48 hp) and
  develops a maximum torque of 43 Nm.
  What is its range?
  With fuel consumption of 3.8 l/100 km and a 14-litre fuel tank,
  the BMW F 450 R has a range of more than 350 km.
  What is the Easy Ride Clutch?
  In combination with BMW Shift Assistant Pro, the rider no longer
  needs to operate the clutch lever when moving off, stopping or
  changing gear. This is particularly practical in urban traffic with
  frequent stops. The clutch lever remains in place and can still be
  used when required.
  What rider heights is the BMW F 450 R suitable for?
  With three available seat heights of 775 mm (low seat), 790 mm
  (standard) and 810 mm (high seat), the BMW F 450 R can be adapted to
  suit riders of different heights. The slim contour below the seat also
  enables most riders to reach the ground very easily.
  Which licence class was the BMW F 450 R developed for?
  With an output of 35 kW (48 hp), the BMW F 450 R meets the
  requirements of the European A2 licence class.

documents.title: The new BMW X5.
documents.raw_text:
The new BMW X5 adds another chapter to its story of success. The
  fifth generation of the BMW X5 impresses with technical innovations, a
  stunning new design and the integration of future-oriented
  technologies from the Neue Klasse. This underlines its exceptional
  status and reinforces its leading position in a segment that it
  originally established.
  First model from the brand with
  five different drive system types.
  As the first Sports Activity Vehicle (SAV) from the brand and
  founding father of the eminently successful BMW X family, the
  trendsetting BMW X5 has been shaping the future in innovative style
  since its introduction in 1999. Embodying that very same aspiration,
  the new BMW X5 is the first model from the brand to come to market
  with a choice of five different drive system types.
In addition to variants with petrol or diesel combustion engines,
  including 48V mild hybrid technology, and plug-in hybrid models, the
  fifth generation of the successful model does not just encompass the
  first all-electric BMW iX5. The BMW iX5 Hydrogen is also set to
  celebrate its market launch – at a later stage – as the first
  hydrogen-powered BMW production vehicle. The powertrain encompasses
  the fuel cell system, in-car hydrogen storage with the new BMW
  Hydrogen Flat Storage technology and an innovative high-voltage
  battery. The third generation of the fuel cell system enables a
  particularly compact design within a high-performance, efficient drive
  system with a range of up to 750 kilometres (466 miles)[1].
The new BMW iX5 – the first battery-electric BMW X5 – is launching
  with the sixth generation of BMW’s eDrive technology. This means
  longer ranges of up to 845 kilometres (525 miles) in the
  BMW iX5 60 xDrive, fast charging, 800V technology and practical
  bidirectional charging. This is thanks to new cylindrical cells with a
  height of 120 millimetres, installed in the high-voltage battery and
  in use for the first time in the new BMW iX5.
“With its imposing presence and flawless symbiosis of comfort and
  driving pleasure, the BMW X5 became a global bestseller,” says
  Dr. Joachim Post, Member of the Board of Management of BMW AG
  responsible for Development. “And now the latest generation also
  benefits from the technologies in the Neue Klasse and the widest
  possible range of drive systems. As a result, I’m sure the new BMW X5
  will set the benchmark in its class once again and write the next
  chapter in its success story.”
  New design: unmistakeable presence from every perspective.
  The new BMW X5 also takes a major leap forward in terms of
  design. Viewed from any perspective, the clear, monolithic and
  powerful appearance of the car embodies the confident presence that
  underlines its leading position in the segment, becoming one of the
  key faces of the brand. This is in large part down to the effortless
  melding of classic SAV proportions with the forward-looking BMW design
  language of the Neue Klasse to produce a harmonious, distinct end result.
The next generation of the distinctive X exterior is characterised by
  the upright design of the front end, the vertically aligned BMW kidney
  Iconic Glow and the new “double-X” light icons, making their first
  appearance in a BMW. The clearly structured side view of the BMW X5 is
  particularly impressive, thanks in large part to the innovative door
  handles, the BMW Winglets. These combine progressive design with
  functional convenience: recessed handles requires the lightest of
  touches to open the electrically powered doors.
Naturally, all models offer broad scope for tailoring the design,
  including eleven exterior paint colours and a precisely curated wheel
  range that now boasts 23-inch rims. The new BMW X5 M60e xDrive creates
  visual highlights emphasising its role as the sporting flagship, while
  the M Sport package and the M Sport package Pro provide a range of
  distinctive features.
  High-quality M Performance Parts available.
  In addition, high-quality M Performance Parts are available
  for the BMW X5. Highlights of the range include striking exterior
  items such as the M Performance front splitter carbon fibre,
  M Performance roof spoiler black high-gloss, M Performance rear
  diffuser aramid and M Performance exterior mirror caps aramid. Also
  available are M Performance summer and winter complete wheels in 21-
  and 23-inch formats. The cabin can likewise be given an even sportier
  look with items such as the M Performance floor mats.
  Spacious, natural and innovative: redesigned interior combines
    feel good atmosphere with digital user experience.
  One glance at the redesigned interior immediately reveals the
  extremely high quality of the new BMW X5. The interior impresses with
  clear structures and uncluttered surfaces, producing a harmonious
  sense of space and calmly providing subtle support for classic BMW
  driver orientation.
The outstanding visual and haptic quality of the interior is also
  underlined by the new decorative surfaces constructed from materials
  such as slate and glass that generate an atmosphere of elemental
  sophistication. BMW is the first carmaker worldwide to offer slate as
  an optional decorative surface.
The BMW X5 incorporates core technologies from the Neue Klasse in the
  form of the new BMW Panoramic iDrive display and operating system,
  underpinned by BMW Operating System X. These include the Central
  Display in free-cut design, the BMW 3D Head-Up Display, the
  BMW Passenger Screen available as an optional extra in the BMW X5 for
  the first time, the BMW Panoramic Vision with a projection surface
  extending across the full width of the windscreen and the new
  multifunction steering wheel. This results in an all-encompassing
  digital user experience centred around both the driver and their passengers.
The BMW X5 combines fascinating new technologies with a genuinely
  feel-good interior atmosphere. This is expressed in the lighting
  animations provided by the ambient light strip, a central element that
  creates an inviting wrap-around effect from door to door to generate a
  harmonious atmosphere.
  BMW X5 combines a high level of comfort with BMW typical
    driving dynamics and intelligent driver assistance systems.
  As the sportiest SUV in its segment, the BMW X5 has long set
  standards in terms of driving dynamics – and the latest generation
  of the BMW X5 is equally impressive in its this respect. This is due
  in no small part to the adaptive suspension fitted as standard and
  axle load distribution close to 50:50. Optional extras include
  Adaptive Chassis Control, as well as the Adaptive Chassis Control
  Professional with roll stabilisation initially available for every
  all‑electric and plug‑in hybrid model. This system leads the way
  when it comes to blending BMW’s characteristic driving dynamics with
  maximum ride comfort.
BMW Symbiotic Drive provides intelligent support tailored to
  individual driving behaviour. The advanced Level 2 driver assistance
  systems and active safety functions are designed down to the smallest
  detail for seamless interaction between assistance and human driving.
  In the BMW iX5 models, and in the upcoming BMW iX5 Hydrogen, the
  Heart of Joy also enables a very special experience: BMW Soft-Stop,
  which executes the smoothest stopping action every provided by BMW.
  Production and premiere in Spartanburg.
  The market launch of the first variants of the new BMW X5 is
  scheduled for late November 2026, with the all-electric and
  plug‑in hybrid versions to follow in early 2027. Production of the
  new models will ramp up some months ahead of this, with
  BMW Group Plant Spartanburg (USA) initiating series production of the
  fifth-generation BMW X5 in August 2026.
Plant Spartanburg has been producing the X5 ever since it was
  launched – founding a new market segment – in 1999. And now the
  facility is celebrating a new premiere: the new BMW iX5 will be the
  first all-electric vehicle to be manufactured there. The new factory
  for sixth-generation high-voltage batteries built for this model
  variant adjacent to BMW Group Plant Spartanburg requires no fossil
  fuels for normal operations. This is just one of many examples of the
  BMW Group’s rigorous approach to minimising CO2e emissions
  during production.
      [1] As this is a
      prototype in the development phase, the statutory WLTP consumption
      data is not yet available.
    The German Federal Ministry of Transport (BMV) is funding
      development of the powertrain and the tank system for the BMW iX5
      Hydrogen in the "HyPowerDrive" project, as part of the
      IPCEI Hy2Move framework. The federal government of Germany is
      providing funding of 191 million EUR. In addition, the state of
      Bavaria is (co-)financing the project to a total of 82 million
      EUR. The funding is implemented by project sponsor Jülich (PtJ)
      and coordinated by NOW GmbH.

documents.raw_text:
Airbus forecasts growing services market to double by 2045
  Toulouse, France, 14 October 2026 – Airbus anticipates that total demand for aviation services will double from 2026 reaching an estimated value of more than US$420 billion by 2045. These services, which sustain the aviation sector’s robustness, will grow at a 3.8% compound annual growth rate (CAGR), supporting  an increasing world aircraft fleet of 45,550 by 2045. Over the same 20 year period, passenger numbers will double to 10 billion. This will lead to a cumulative need for 730,000 maintenance technicians, 660,000 pilots and 1,050,000 cabin crew, totalling more than 2.44 million additional skilled people.Digital solutions and connectivity underpin all sectors of the services market supporting airlines to improve operational efficiency, reduce disruptions such as delays and cancellations, maintenance agility and real-time connectivity to meet passenger expectations for a seamless journey.Airbus’ GSF outlines six key services segments:Off-Wing Maintenance (2045: US$217 billion, +3.7% CAGR) – Doubling in value driven by an increasing number of shop visits due to aging and growing global fleet. Material supply is significant reflecting demand for parts support and repair.Maintenance Operations Support (2045: US$104 billion, +4.3% CAGR) – The addition of this new cluster includes inventory provision on time and on quality and engineering support to ensure continued airworthiness and aircraft reliability.On-Wing Maintenance (2045: US$36 billion, +2.8% CAGR) – Covering light inspections to heavy checks and growing in line with the overall growing global fleet.Digital & Connectivity (2045: US$27 billion, +5.3% CAGR) – The fastest-growing market, this is expected to triple over the next two decades.Modifications & Upgrades (2045: US$21 billion, +2.6% CAGR) – Upgrades of older aircraft through cabin retrofits and modern technology integration. Training (2045: US$17 billion, +3.1% CAGR) – Addressing a massive new workforce requirement, the industry must intensify efforts to attract and train new talent.As the global fleet doubles to more than 45,550 aircraft by 2045, we need to get ready. Airbus is expanding its role as an integral services partner to support our customers across the entire aircraft lifecycle. By integrating predictive operations, fleet modernisation, and advanced digital solutions, we are helping airlines ensure fleet availability, reliability, safety and long-term operational excellence,” highlights Cristina Aguilar Grieder, SVP Customer Services Commercial Aircraft at Airbus.In the next 20 years, Europe & CIS, North America and China will remain the largest services markets in terms of total demand, while Asia (Asia-Pacific, China and South Asia) is projected to be the fastest growing. The Airbus GSF is aircraft agnostic, focusing on passenger jets with a capacity exceeding 100 seats and freighters with a payload capability above 10 tonnes.

documents.title: Avolon orders 35 Airbus A330-900 and 75 A320neo Family aircraft
documents.raw_text:
Avolon orders 35 Airbus A330-900 and 75 A320neo Family aircraft
  Toulouse, France, 09 October 2026 - Avolon, a leading global aviation finance company, has placed a firm order for 110 Airbus aircraft, comprising 35 A330-900 and 75 A320neo Family aircraft. This incremental order takes Avolon’s total for the A330-900 to 114 aircraft and the A320 Family to some 650."We continue to see strong demand for new aircraft, and this order further strengthens our long-term delivery pipeline. This positions us to support our airline customers' fleet growth and replacement requirements well into the next decade. We expect demand for both the A330neo and A320neo to remain strong given the long-term growth trajectory of the aviation sector, and we are delighted to further expand our longstanding partnership with Airbus through this agreement,” said Andy Cronin, Avolon CEO.“This is a major order for both the A330neo and the A320neo Family and we thank Avolon for its repeated endorsement of our products,” said Benoît de Saint-Exupéry, Airbus EVP Sales of the Commercial Aircraft business. “With this acquisition, Avolon confirms its position as the leading lessor for the A330-900, having purchased 114 of the type from Airbus. It is also another demonstration of the strong demand for the A330neo and A320neo from the lessor community, who clearly value the broad market appeal and flexibility these two products offer in the market space from domestic to regional to long haul routes.” Powered by the latest generation Rolls-Royce Trent 7000 engines, the A330neo is designed to fly up to 8,100 nautical miles / 15,000 kilometers non-stop and reduces fuel burn, CO₂ emissions and operating cost by 25% compared to previous generation competitor aircraft. The A330neo unique Airspace cabin offers passengers and crews the latest modern in-flight products for a comfortable flying experience.The A320 Family is the world’s most popular single-aisle aircraft, having won more than 20,400 orders globally. The Family includes the largest member, the A321neo, offering unparalleled range and performance. The Family offers at least 20% fuel savings and CO₂ reduction compared to previous generation single-aisle aircraft, while maximising passenger comfort with one of the widest single-aisle cabins in the sky. @avolon_aero @Airbus #A330neo #A321neo

                  Safari BrowserContinue with the current browser Press Release08 October 2026Digital IndustriesErlangen      Siemens to digitalize one of Europe's largest renewable
hydrogen projects
                    Siemens deploys its software portfolio for hydrogen at industrial scale, shaping the future of digitally optimized renewable hydrogen production
                    Physics-based digital twin and real-time optimization
                    100 MW facility to produce up to 15,000 tons of renewable hydrogen per year, targeting 110,000 tons of CO₂ reduction per year
                    Siemens deploys its software portfolio for hydrogen at industrial scale, shaping the future of digitally optimized renewable hydrogen production
                    Physics-based digital twin and real-time optimization
                    100 MW facility to produce up to 15,000 tons of renewable hydrogen per year, targeting 110,000 tons of CO₂ reduction per year
          Siemens
and Portugal-based Galp Energia are collaborating to digitalize GalpH2Park in Sines,
Portugal. The plant will be one of Europe's
largest renewable hydrogen plants once it starts operating at year-end. For the 100 MW hydrogen facility of the first
project phase, Siemens is deploying its software portfolio for the hydrogen
industry, enabling smarter operations and optimizing the value of the plant. With
this deployment, Galp and Siemens are shaping the future of digitally optimized
renewable hydrogen production on an industrial scale.
                Digital
twin at the heart
            Central
to the collaboration is Siemens' Hydrogen Performance Suite (HPS) – an advanced
digital cockpit designed to continuously enhance renewable hydrogen plant
operations. At its core lies a predictive Digital Process Twin: a high-fidelity
model built on physics-based modeling that delivers operational insights via
real-time optimization for faster and data-driven decision-making. To power the
digital twin, Siemens deploys an integrated software stack for process
modelling, data analytics and real-time visualization – translating complex
plant data into clear, actionable insights for operators. By
seamlessly integrating the digital twin with live plant data and external
sources, such as grid operators and energy markets, the HPS gives Galp’s
operators end-to-end visibility of their facility. The result is smarter
production scheduling, and optimized energy procurement. Siemens estimates that
the HPS can deliver energy savings of up to 15 percent – a significant lever
for both cost competitiveness and sustainability."GalpH2Park
is a lighthouse for Europe's energy transition”, said Axel Lorenz, Executive Vice
President Automation Process Industries at Siemens. “We are convinced that
digital innovation is the key to making renewable hydrogen economically viable
and accelerating the decarbonization of industry. Siemens is turning this
ambition into industrial reality – at scale."
                Reducing
greenhouse gas emissions
            Powered
by renewable electricity sourced through long-term supply agreements and Galp's
own renewable generation capacity, the GalpH2Park plant is set to produce up to 15,000 tons of renewable hydrogen per year.
This is expected to reduce greenhouse gas emissions by approximately 110,000 tons
of CO₂ equivalent per year (Scope
1) – a meaningful contribution to Portugal's and Europe's decarbonization
targets.Siemens
offers a comprehensive portfolio of digital and automation solutions for the
hydrogen industry – spanning monitoring and control systems, industrial
automation, digital twin, power protection and distribution, and drives. With a
holistic approach that integrates electrification, advanced instrumentation,
and state-of-the-art digital services, Siemens is actively accelerating
industrial decarbonization and the global energy transition.For this press release PDF DownloadSiemens Digital Industries (DI) empowers companies of all sizes within the process and discrete manufacturing industries to accelerate their digital and sustainability transformation across the entire value chain. Berlin
                Siemens Mobility and Transport for London presented the new Inspiro London Piccadilly line train at the Piccadilly Showcase Event during InnoTrans 2026
                Visitors also experienced Siemens Mobility's digital rail solutions, including Railigent X, showcasing how data-driven technologies can improve performance, and reliability across the railway
                80% of Transport for London’s 94-train order for the new Piccadilly line fleet is being manufactured at Siemens Mobility's £240 million Goole Rail Village in the UK.
        This week at the biannual InnoTrans exhibition,
Siemens Mobility showcased the new Inspiro London Piccadilly line train.
Following addresses from Siemens Mobility Chief Executive Officer Michael
Peter, Transport for London Commissioner Andy Lord and Aglaja Schneider, Joint
CEO of Siemens Mobility UK&I, attendees were invited aboard the
113-metre-long, nine-car train for a guided tour to provide a first-hand look
at the innovative features and passenger-focused enhancements designed for
London's future Piccadilly line journeys.

                Visitors also experienced Siemens Mobility's digital rail solutions, including Railigent X, showcasing how data-driven technologies can improve performance, and reliability across the railway
                80% of Transport for London’s 94-train order for the new Piccadilly line fleet is being manufactured at Siemens Mobility's £240 million Goole Rail Village in the UK.
        This week at the biannual InnoTrans exhibition,
Siemens Mobility showcased the new Inspiro London Piccadilly line train.
Following addresses from Siemens Mobility Chief Executive Officer Michael
Peter, Transport for London Commissioner Andy Lord and Aglaja Schneider, Joint
CEO of Siemens Mobility UK&I, attendees were invited aboard the
113-metre-long, nine-car train for a guided tour to provide a first-hand look
at the innovative features and passenger-focused enhancements designed for
London's future Piccadilly line journeys.   vlnr: Michael Peter, CEO Siemens
Mobility ; Andy Lord, London’s Transport Commissioner,  Aglaja
Schneider, Joint CEO and Managing Director, Rolling Stock and Customer Services
at Siemens Mobility UK&I
                Andy Lord, London’s Transport Commissioner, said:
“These new trains will fundamentally change the
experience of travelling on the Piccadilly line when they start entering
service. They will become one of the first things an international visitor will
experience when they come to London, be it through Heathrow or St Pancras
International, and will be more energy efficient and spacious, provide CCTV and
air conditioning and give customers better information during their journeys.
Journeys will be more accessible, safer and faster, and the experience for our
customers will be transformed.”  The new Piccadilly line trains have been designed to
transform the passenger experience with air-conditioning, walk-through
carriages, enhanced accessibility, onboard CCTV and improved onboard digital
information systems. The trains will also be more reliable, increase capacity
by 10% and consume 20% less energy than the existing fleet. The trains will be
digitally connected via our Railigent platform, meaning trains will be able to
send live location data and live component health data to TfL’s depots, enabling
predictive maintenance.  Aglaja Schneider, Joint CEO and Managing Director, Rolling Stock and Customer Services at Siemens Mobility UK&I, said:  “I’m incredibly proud to see the new Piccadilly line
train exhibited at InnoTrans. Having been part of this programme earlier in its
development, it's fantastic to see how far the project has come and to share
that progress with the wider rail industry.
I would like to thank the teams across Siemens
Mobility and Transport for London for their hard work and collaboration. From
design and manufacturing through to testing, teams from both organisations have
worked side by side to bring the project to life. Built at our Goole Rail
Village in East Yorkshire, it also represents our continued investment in UK
manufacturing and skills.”Alongside the train, Siemens Mobility showcased its
portfolio of digitally connected rail solutions, including Railigent X,
Signaling X and Mobility Software Suite X. Powered by Siemens Xcelerator, these
technologies help operators optimise performance, improve reliability and make
better use of rail infrastructure, supporting the delivery of a more efficient
and sustainable railway.Notes to editors:
Siemens Mobility is
investing up to £240 million in the Goole Rail Village, a site that spans 67
acres, the size of 35 football pitches. London Underground’s new Piccadilly
line trains will be assembled at Goole before they
begin operating between December 2026 - June 2027.Overall, Siemens Mobility’s
investment will bring up to 1,000 new jobs to the East Riding of Yorkshire, as
well as around 1,700 supply chain opportunities, promoting localisation and
helping to serve other global markets by 2030.The Goole Rail Village is a fully
integrated rail hub, consisting of the Train Manufacturing Facility which
assembles and commissions trains, the Components Facility where Siemens
maintains gearboxes, traction motors and other parts for train and tram fleets,
the Logistics Centre warehousing facility, and the Rail Accelerator and
Innovation Solutions hub for Enterprise (RaisE) business centre.
With additional investment of up to £40 million, all of this will be
joined by a Bogie Assembly and Service Centre, which will incorporate and
expand Siemens Mobility’s current capabilities to overhaul bogies from UK
trains.Siemens Mobility has
supported the local supply chain wherever possible, contracting Leeds-based GMI
Construction for the build of the Goole factory,
Components Facility and the warehouse. The GMI supply chain is based
entirely in the UK with over 70% of it based in Yorkshire. Several components
for the Piccadilly line trains will also come from local Yorkshire and UK
suppliers, such as the exterior lighting from LPA Lighting, just 25 miles away
from the Goole factory. For this press release PDF Download
        Siemens Mobility is a separately managed company of Siemens AG. As a leader in intelligent transport solutions for more than 175 years, Siemens Mobility is constantly innovating its portfolio. Its core areas include rolling stock, rail automation and electrification, a comprehensive software portfolio, turnkey systems as well as related services. With digital products and solutions, and the use of industrial AI, Siemens Mobility is enabling mobility operators worldwide to make their infrastructure intelligent, increase value sustainably over the entire lifecycle, enhance passenger experience, and guarantee availability. In fiscal year 2025, which ended on September 30, 2025, Siemens Mobility posted revenue of €12.4 billion and employed around 43,400 people worldwide. Further information is available at:

Operating across more than 100 countries, TD SYNNEX connects a broad ecosystem of technology vendors and partners through specialist expertise, enablement, services and digital platforms.  Siemens and TD SYNNEX, one of the world’s leading technology distributor and solution aggregators, have agreed on a joint framework to establish a global distribution partnership.The partnership aims to bring together Siemens’ technology and domain expertise with TD SYNNEX’s extensive IT ecosystem, creating new opportunities for technology partners as physical AI emerges and IT/OT convergence accelerates.TD SYNNEX’s ecosystem spans technology providers, solution providers, systems integrators, hyperscalers, independent software vendors (ISVs) Managed Service Providers (MSPs), providing a platform to connect and aggregate complementary technologies and capabilities. This relationship is designed to broaden access to solutions spanning industrial automation, software and AI, cybersecurity, intelligent infrastructure and electrification.“With the incredible pace of change driven by AI, bringing IT and OT closer together has never been more important,” said Alastair Borissow, Head of Global Distribution Sales, Siemens. “By combining our established and highly capable global OT distribution network with TD SYNNEX’s complementary strengths in IT distribution, scale and ecosystem we intend to create new opportunities for our entire distribution channel. Together, we have the opportunity to deliver end-to-end capabilities for customers across the entire Siemens technology portfolio.”“IT and OT convergence is creating significant opportunities for partners to connect enterprise technology with the systems that power industries, infrastructure and buildings,” said Cheryl Day, senior vice president, New Vendor Acquisition & Global Solutions, TD SYNNEX. “By combining Siemens' industrial technology expertise with TD SYNNEX's global partner ecosystem, enablement capabilities and value-added services, we can help partners access new markets, develop new skills and address emerging opportunities in areas such as industrial AI, automation, cybersecurity and digital infrastructure.” “This is about far more than the distribution
of technology - it is about connecting the industrial and IT worlds at
unprecedented scale – by combining Siemens’ deep industrial technology with TD
SYNNEX’s extraordinary reach across the global IT ecosystem - from hyperscalers
and technology providers to thousands of specialist partners,” said Dion Smith,
head of Global Partner Ecosystem, Siemens. “We aim to create new routes to
market, engage new buying centers within existing customers and reach entirely
new customers, while accelerating the convergence of IT and OT. Together, we
have the opportunity to unlock a trillion-dollar market and make secure
industrial digitalization more accessible, scalable and impactful
worldwide.”  For this press release PDF DownloadLinks TD SYNNEX Blog Siemens LinkedIn Siemens

               Lower Saxony Transport Authority (LNVG) and Greater Braunschweig Regional Association (RGB) award contract for 113 three-car Mireo Plus B battery trains, maintenance, and depots valued at over two billion euros
83 vehicles for Lower Saxony Transport Authority and an additional 30 trains for Greater Braunschweig Regional Association
                Two new maintenance facilities in Lower Saxony, including long-term digital maintenance over 30 years and up to 100 future-proof jobs
              Option for the procurement of an additional 132 trains
               Lower Saxony Transport Authority (LNVG) and Greater Braunschweig Regional Association (RGB) award contract for 113 three-car Mireo Plus B battery trains, maintenance, and depots valued at over two billion euros
83 vehicles for Lower Saxony Transport Authority and an additional 30 trains for Greater Braunschweig Regional Association

           Siemens Mobility has
received a major order from the Landesnahverkehrsgesellschaft Niedersachsen
(LNVG) and the Regionalverband Großraum Braunschweig (RGB) for battery-powered
regional trains. The order includes 113 three-car Mireo Plus B trains, an
extensive 30-year service package, and the construction of two Rail Service
Centers in Lower Saxony. The contract also includes options for up to 132
additional rail vehicles. The trains will enter passenger service starting at
the end of 2031.Michael Peter, President, Siemens Mobility: “With the world’s largest order for battery-powered trains, we are working alongside our partners in Lower Saxony to drive forward the decarbonisation of rail transport and demonstrate that sustainable mobility is already economically viable and scalable today. Our Mireo Plus B battery-powered trains offer emission-free operation, high availability and first-class passenger comfort. In combination with our digital service and maintenance concept, Railigent X, we are laying the foundations for efficient and reliable fleet operation throughout the vehicles’ 30-year life cycle. At the same time, we are investing in service and maintenance capacity as well as skilled local jobs. In this way, we are creating long-term added value for passengers, transport authorities and the region.”About Mireo Plus BWith the proven Mireo
Plus B, Siemens Mobility offers a tried-and-tested battery-electric platform
for sustainable and economical regional transport on routes that are only
partially electrified. The high-performance, three-car vehicles, valued at around
1.1 billion euros, enable emission-free operation without continuous overhead
lines, reach speeds of up to 160 km/h, and make a significant contribution to
the decarbonization of rail transport. The batteries are charged while
traveling under overhead lines and subsequently enable emission-free operation
on route sections without catenary wires.The 113 three-car,
battery-electric Mireo Plus B trains offer an exceptionally high level of
accessibility and passenger comfort. Due to doors with different levels of entry
height, level boarding and a comfortable entry at different platform heights is
mostly possible. Two wheelchair spaces, spacious multi-purpose areas, as well
as modern passenger information systems and Wi-Fi ensure a pleasant journey for
all passengers. Furthermore, the trains features more than 170 seats, including
at least six seats in 1st class. For bicycle transport, there are at least six
storage spaces per train, which can be expanded to up to 18 spaces if required.30-Year service contract and two new rail service
centersIn addition to
vehicle delivery, the contract includes comprehensive customer service
provisions. For long-term and reliable operation of the fleet, the contract
relies on Siemens Mobility's comprehensive operations and maintenance concept,
Railigent X. The core of the project is a 30-year full-service contract for the
113 battery-electric Mireo Plus B trains. Siemens Mobility will assume full
maintenance of the vehicles and support a near-hundred-percent operational
availability. The service package includes modern digital services for
condition-based maintenance and fleet performance optimization, comprehensive
asset management, supply of spare parts, and maintenance services throughout
the entire lifecycle of the trains. Additionally, training programs for
operations and maintenance personnel ensure that reliable expertise is built up
and that efficient and resource-saving operation is guaranteed.For the Lower Saxony
BEMU project, a modern maintenance infrastructure for the battery-electric
vehicles is planned. This involves a workshop concept that encompasses both
operational running maintenance of the vehicles and the centralization of
overhauls and heavy maintenance work in a center of competence. This is
complemented by additional local facilities for regional vehicle care. Up to 100
future-proof jobs will be created. The concept combines high fleet availability
with economical operational processes, therefore establishing the foundation
for long-term reliable and sustainable rail transport in Lower Saxony.   For this press release PDF Download
