						LG Electronics Advances the LG Sound Suite Experience With New DTS:X Support, Greater Flexibility and Expanded Home Theater Capabilities
    New Enhancements Give Consumers More Ways to Enjoy Immersive
Home Theater Experiences and Premium Audio Content
    News Summary
LG continues expanding the flexibility and immersive audio capabilities of LG Sound Suite, the world’s first soundbar audio system powered by Dolby Atmos® FlexConnect™, giving consumers more ways to enjoy premium home entertainment.New DTS:X support on the H7 soundbar expands immersive audio possibilities for home theater enthusiasts and reflects LG’s commitment to listening to customer feedback.Support for dual W7 subwoofers, Wi‑Fi 6 GHz networks and stereo configurations on 5 GHz DFS channels further expands the flexibility that defines the LG Sound Suite experience.Google Cast support and broader compatibility enhancements strengthen the LG Sound Suite ecosystem, making it easier for consumers to access content and create the audio system that best fits their home.
SEOUL, Oct. 14, 2026 — LG Electronics (LG) continues to expand the flexibility and immersive audio capabilities of LG Sound Suite, the world’s first soundbar audio system powered by Dolby Atmos® FlexConnect™. Recent enhancements have expanded content compatibility, increased system flexibility and given consumers more ways to enjoy immersive home entertainment experiences.1
Introduced at CES® 2026, LG Sound Suite redefined home audio by combining the simplicity of wireless setup with the flexibility to create a personalized Dolby Atmos experience. Since its debut, LG has continued expanding the capabilities of LG Sound Suite. The latest enhancements build on that foundation, expanding the ways consumers can configure, connect and enjoy LG Sound Suite in their homes.
“LG Sound Suite was created to make immersive audio more flexible, more accessible and easier to enjoy,” said Lee Jeong-seok, head of the LG Media Entertainment Solution Company’s Audio Business Division. “These latest enhancements reflect our ongoing commitment to expanding what LG Sound Suite can do, giving consumers more freedom to build the audio experience that best fits their home, their content and the way they listen.”
More Ways to Enjoy Immersive Audio
As streaming, gaming and premium home entertainment continue to evolve, consumers are looking for audio experiences that match the stunning visuals delivered by today’s televisions. To help expand those possibilities, LG has expanded LG Sound Suite with DTS:X support for the H7 soundbar, giving home theater enthusiasts additional ways to enjoy immersive, multi-dimensional audio from compatible content and source devices.
This enhancement reflects LG’s ongoing commitment to listening to customers and expanding the capabilities of LG Sound Suite in response to enthusiast feedback seeking broader immersive audio compatibility.
By introducing DTS:X support today, LG is laying the foundation for even more immersive audio experiences across the LG Sound Suite ecosystem.
As part of this effort, LG is also developing the LG Media Connect Hub, designed to help customers enjoy DTS:X playback from compatible external source devices and further expand access to DTS:X content. Additional details will be shared through official channels at a later date.2
Expanding the Flexibility of Dolby Atmos FlexConnect
Flexibility has been central to LG Sound Suite from the very beginning.
Unlike traditional home theater systems that often require fixed speaker layouts and complex installation, LG Sound Suite allows users to build the system that works best for their space. LG has also expanded compatibility across home networking environments through support for Wi‑Fi 6 GHz networks and 5 GHz DFS channels. These enhancements allow more consumers to enjoy stereo and multi-speaker configurations while preserving the simplicity and flexibility that define the LG Sound Suite experience.
By making setup and connectivity more adaptable to real-world home environments, LG continues to strengthen one of the system’s key advantages: immersive audio that fits naturally into the way people live.
More Freedom to Build the System You Want
LG has expanded system customization options through support for connecting two W7 subwoofers within compatible LG Sound Suite configurations.
While designed to provide greater flexibility for larger listening spaces, the dual-subwoofer capability is about more than increased output. By enabling additional placement options, the enhancement helps improve bass consistency throughout a room, delivering more balanced low-frequency performance across multiple seating positions. The feature further reinforces LG Sound Suite’s modular approach, allowing users to start with a configuration that fits their needs today and expand over time as their entertainment preferences evolve.
Broader Compatibility Across Content and Entertainment Ecosystems
LG has expanded content access through Google Cast support on the H7 soundbar, giving users additional ways to stream music, podcasts and entertainment content directly to their LG Sound Suite systems.
Combined with Dolby Atmos, Dolby Atmos FlexConnect, Sound Follow, Room Calibration Pro and LG’s modular wireless architecture, these enhancements continue to expand the capabilities of the LG Sound Suite ecosystem while preserving the simplicity that made the system distinctive from day one.
Continuing the Vision of Flexible Immersive Audio
Audio continues to play an increasingly important role in home entertainment as consumers seek experiences that match the quality of today’s premium televisions and content platforms.
From expanded DTS:X compatibility and dual-subwoofer configurations to broader wireless connectivity and content access, LG continues strengthening the flexibility that defines the LG Sound Suite experience.
By giving consumers more ways to enjoy Dolby Atmos, Dolby Atmos FlexConnect and immersive home entertainment, LG Sound Suite continues delivering on its original promise: simple, flexible and immersive audio that is right for their home.
# # #
1 Features are delivered via software updates. Availability, timing and supported features, including Wi‑Fi 6 GHz and 5 GHz DFS channel support, may vary by model, country/region, router compatibility and software version.
2 Product availability, features and timing are subject to change.

						LG Electronics Announces New Smart Home Accessories, Designed in Collaboration With Apple for the Apple Home Collection
     The New Products Advance LG’s Zero Labor Home Vision
 Across Indoor and Outdoor Living Spaces
    News Summary
LG Electronics and Apple announced the seven smart home accessories for the Apple Home Collection, including indoor and outdoor cameras, a video doorbell, smart lock, smart thermostat and temperature sensor.The new products are co-developed by LG Electronics and Apple, and work seamlessly with Apple devices. The collaboration goes beyond device compatibility, combining LG’s deep knowledge of product and homes with Apple’s platform expertise to deliver a more intuitive and integrated smart home experience.These products work together seamlessly to help users with their daily routines, including monitoring and protecting their homes while away.
NEW YORK, Oct. 13, 2026 — LG Electronics (LG) today announced a range of smart home accessories co-developed with Apple for the Apple Home Collection, including indoor and outdoor cameras, and a video doorbell, smart lock, smart thermostat and temperature sensor. The new products are designed to make the everyday home experience simpler, more reliable and seamlessly connected and private in Apple Home.
These smart home accessories represent LG’s commitment to creating connected and adaptive experiences. They also advance the company’s ambition to simplify everyday living by reducing the need for manual intervention and enabling more intuitive interactions between customers and their environments.
“Creating a truly connected home requires products that work seamlessly together,” said Kihyun Jung, head of the Platform Business Center at the LG Home Appliance Solution Company. “By bringing LG’s expertise in home appliances and the home environment together with the Apple Home, we are creating intuitive, integrated experiences that fit naturally into customers' daily lives.”
“Apple has always focused on making products and experiences that are seamless and intuitive, and protect our users’ privacy — and that matters more than ever in the home,” said Matthew Costello, Apple's vice president of Hardware Engineering. “Combining our hardware and software expertise with LG’s deep understanding of the home and connected living lets us build smart home experiences that are simpler to set up, are easier to control, and work effortlessly.”
Moving Beyond Connectivity to Co-Develop Products and User Experiences
Moving beyond just device compatibility, Apple and LG developed these new products together from the early product planning stage, collaborating on hardware, software and user experiences.
Each product is designed with a consistent user experience in mind to streamline setup and control. Rather than simply linking individual products through a platform, the accessories are designed to work together. Using the Home app or Siri to control a single “Good Morning” scene can simultaneously adjust the thermostat and tilt an indoor camera down while a user is getting ready.1 And each accessory is encrypted end-to-end in Apple Home, so only users and the people they choose can access their home data.
Introducing New Indoor and Outdoor Cameras, a Video Doorbell, Smart Lock, Thermostat and Temperature Sensor
Starting in December, with select accessories coming early next year, LG and Apple are launching the full lineup in the United States and Canada, including indoor and outdoor cameras, a video doorbell, a smart lock, a thermostat and a temperature sensor with support for Apple Home and LG ThinQ apps.1 In the United Kingdom, indoor and outdoor cameras and a video doorbell will be available starting December.2
Cameras
 LG’s new indoor and outdoor cameras deliver clear imaging, intelligent detection and privacy-focused controls to help users monitor what matters around their homes. With up to 2.5K video resolution, low-light color night vision, and wide-angle coverage, the cameras provide clear views during the day and at night. Using intelligence, each camera recognizes people, pets, vehicles and motion, helping deliver more relevant alerts and reducing unnecessary notifications. Users can also block selected areas from view and recording, while built-in local storage provides greater control over how recorded footage is stored and reviewed.LG Indoor Cam Plug-In: A wide 160° field of view captures more of the room in a single frame, while a privacy tilt mechanism and physical controls provide a visible and intuitive way to control monitoring when it is not needed.LG Outdoor Cam Plug-In: The camera provides reliable outdoor monitoring with low light color night vision, and 2.5K resolution, helping users maintain a clear view around the home day and night.LG Floodlight Cam: The camera adds dual adaptive floodlights that automatically illuminate the surrounding area when activity is detected, combining outdoor monitoring and lighting in one integrated home security solution.
LG Video Doorbell Wired
 LG Video Doorbell Wired brings clear visibility, more relevant alerts and everyday convenience to the front door. Its dual-camera system combines a 2.5K front camera and a Full HD bottom camera, capturing separate views of visitors, packages and key areas around the entryway for broader coverage. It can also identify people, vehicles, pets and packages and play a helpful chime through Apple HomeView, HomePod or HomePod mini. Low-light color night vision and two-way talk also help users see and respond to activity at their door.
LG Smart Deadbolt Lock
 LG Smart Deadbolt Lock combines smart access, minimal design and everyday convenience, led by hands-free unlocking with home key on a compatible iPhone or Apple Watch and advanced Ultra-Wideband technology. The lock recognizes an authorized user’s location and movement to support reliable hands-free entry. NFC tap, PIN code and a physical key provide additional ways to unlock the door, while built-in door sensing and real-time app notifications help users monitor door status and security events.
LG Smart Thermostat and LG Temperature Sensor
 LG Smart Thermostat combines energy efficiency, intuitive design to make home comfort more adaptive and efficient. Adaptive Temperature from Apple can adjust heating and cooling based on headed home, away from home or sleeping.
When paired with optional LG Temperature Sensor devices placed in other rooms, the system can monitor temperature and humidity across multiple spaces to support more consistent comfort throughout the home. Advanced sensing algorithms are designed to reduce measurement errors and detect indoor temperature changes in real time, while Matter over Thread enables low-power, responsive connectivity with fewer connection delays and offline disruptions.
In the U.S., Clean Energy Guidance from Apple can help optimize energy use based on grid carbon intensity. Through supported utility-provider integrations, LG Smart Thermostat can also shift operation toward lower-cost periods.
Privacy in Apple Home
 Privacy is foundational to Apple Home. Camera footage and personal data in the Home app is stored end-to-end encrypted and never accessible to LG or Apple.
To learn more about LG and Apple’s smart home accessories, visit LG website.
# # #
1 Use of the new IoT products requires an Apple home hub, like HomePod, HomePod mini, Apple TV 4K or Apple HomeView. The new IoT products, the LG ThinQ, and the Apple Home require a Wi-Fi connection. Available services, features and compatibility may vary depending on product model, region and country.
2 Product availability, including availability at retail stores, may vary by region and country.

documents.raw_text:
Oct 9, 2026
			News Release
Honda Announces “Honda Hybrid” as Name of Next-generation Hybrid System
    —Global Rollout of New Models Equipped with Honda Hybrid Will Begin in 2027
TOKYO, Japan, October 9, 2026 – Honda Motor Co., Ltd. (Honda) today announced an official name for its next-generation hybrid system — Honda Hybrid. In order to respond quickly to growing global demand for hybrid vehicles, Honda has been reallocating its development and production resources toward hybrid business in line with the roadmap toward rebuilding its automobile business, which the company announced in May 2026. As a part of this direction, Honda has revamped its hybrid system and developed the Honda Hybrid, which will be introduced globally starting in 2027.
        Honda Hybrid logo
Based on the technologies amassed through the development of e:HEV, the original Honda two-motor hybrid system, the next-generation Honda Hybrid system further advances the technology to realize both excellent fuel efficiency and the joy of driving that appeals to all senses of the driver, at a high level. To communicate more intuitively to customers around the world about the value proposition of this new hybrid system that is unique only to Honda, the company will rollout “Honda Hybrid” globally also as a communication name for its next-generation hybrid technology.
Honda is planning to launch 15 next-generation hybrid models equipped with Honda Hybrid globally by the end of the fiscal year ending March 31, 2030, primarily in North America. Through various improvements, such as expansion of the high-efficiency operating range of the engine and improvement of the efficiency and downsizing of the drive unit, Honda is striving to further improve the fuel economy of next-generation hybrid models.
Moreover, the next-generation hybrid models equipped with Honda Hybrid systems will be built on the newly-developed platform that achieves both optimized rigidity and weight reduction through the adoption of a new approach to body rigidity management which brings about vehicle behavior as if the body is flexing during cornering and improving roadholding performance. In addition, new features such as a Motion Management System, original Honda integrated control technology, and a newly-developed electric all-wheel-drive system (e-AWD), will enable those models to deliver a high-quality and exhilarating driving experience at the will of the driver, appealing to all senses of the driver, while providing peace of mind.
    Advancement of Honda hybrid technology
IMA (Integrated Motor Assist) – Introduced in 1999
First introduced in the first-generation Insight in 1999, IMA was a lightweight and compact parallel hybrid system in which the engine served as the primary source of power, with the motor assisting the engine during startup and acceleration. As the original Honda hybrid system, IMA achieved both excellent environmental performance and the fun of driving.
SPORT HYBRID i-DCD (Intelligent Dual Clutch Drive) – Introduced in 2012
i-DCD was a one-motor hybrid system featuring a 7-speed dual-clutch transmission (DCT) with a high-output motor integrated into the transmission. In addition to excellent fuel economy, the system delivered powerful acceleration and a rhythmic, leaner acceleration feel.
SPORT HYBRID i-MMD (Intelligent Multi-Mode Drive) – introduced in 2012
i-MMD was a hybrid system equipped with two motors: generator motor and traction motor. With the adoption of high-efficiency, high-output motors, the system delivers excellent fuel economy together with the smooth, powerful driving performance unique only to EVs. With two motors, the system uses efficient motor drive for most daily driving situations. This high-efficiency hybrid system automatically and seamlessly switches among three driving modes according to driving conditions, achieving EV-like smooth and powerful acceleration, a high level of quietness, and excellent environmental performance. From 2020 onward, Honda adopted “e:HEV” as the communication name for this hybrid technology.
SPORT HYBRID SH-AWD (Super Handling All-Wheel Drive) – introduced in 2012
SH-AWD was a three-motor hybrid system that combined an engine and three motors. Original Honda torque-control technology, using right and left independent electric motors for torque vectoring, enabled the system to optimally distribute driving force to all four wheels, achieving both outstanding fuel economy and driving performance.
Honda Hybrid – announced in 2026
Honda Hybrid is a next-generation hybrid system developed by further advancing key components of e:HEV, such as the engine and drive unit, as well as the control technologies. The system name, Honda Hybrid, will also serve as a communication name.

Sep 7, 2026
			News Release
＜FIM Motocross World Championship＞Jeffrey Herlings Claims MXGP World Championship Title
    – Crowned World Champion in His First Year with Honda HRC PETRONAS –
TOKYO, Japan, September 7, 2026 - Honda HRC PETRONAS rider Jeffrey Herlings (31, Netherlands) claimed the series championship in MXGP, the premier class, at Round 17 of the 2026 FIM* Motocross World Championship (MXGP), the Türkiye GP, held from September 5–6.
* FIM: Fédération Internationale de Motocyclisme
        Jeffrey Herlings
        Jeffrey Herlings and the CRF450RW
Herlings joined Honda HRC PETRONAS for the 2026 season and made a strong start with victory at the season-opening Argentina GP. By the end of Round 16, the Netherlands GP, he had recorded 10 victories, including five consecutive wins, and held a commanding 143-point lead over the second-ranked rider, putting him within reach of the championship.
At Round 17, the Türkiye GP, Herlings won the Qualifying Race and then took the holeshot and victory in Race 1. With his resulting points advantage over the second-ranked rider, he secured the MXGP championship with two rounds remaining. He went on to win Race 2 as well, completing an overall victory at the Türkiye GP to celebrate his championship success.
The title is Herlings’ third MXGP World Championship and was achieved in his first season with the team aboard Honda’s factory machine, the CRF450RW.
    Jeffrey Herlings | Honda HRC PETRONAS
“Wow. What a ride it’s been to win this sixth world title. Even since my last one in 2021 to finally get number six is just an incredible feeling. Joining Honda HRC PETRONAS on January 1st and everything being new, new bike, new team, new gear, and it hasn’t always been easy but I think you can see all the work that we’ve done and you can see the results on the track. Just so glad to have made it happen and a big thank you to the team and to my friends and family who have supported me through some tough times.”
    Marcus Pereira de Freitas, Honda HRC PETRONAS Team Manager
“It has been an amazing effort from Jeffrey and the whole team. This year has been one of the hardest years, but I think it proves that hard work pays off because when you look at the performances that Jeffrey has been putting in this year, especially these last few weeks, this championship is exactly what he deserves. He is a tremendous talent and his determination is second to none, and to win this championship in his first season with the team, and on Honda machinery just shows how capable he is as a rider, and the strong capabilities of the bike. A big thank you to Jeffrey, to the whole team at the races, and also everyone back at Japan for helping make this happen, I am proud of everyone.”
    Koji Watanabe, President of Honda Racing Corporation
“I would like to express my sincere respect and gratitude to Jeffrey Herlings for winning the MXGP World Championship in his first year with Honda HRC PETRONAS. In a new environment with a new machine and a new team, he won from the opening round and demonstrated throughout the season the speed and strength of a rider competing at the highest level in the world. In particular, during the second half of the season, he continued to take victories in a variety of track conditions and made powerful progress toward securing the title, inspiring all of us along the way. This title is the result not only of Herlings’ tireless efforts, but also of the entire team—including Team Manager Marcus and all of the staff and riders—coming together under the new structure and continuing to take on the challenge as one. Once again, I would like to express my sincere gratitude to all of the sponsors and everyone involved who have supported Honda HRC PETRONAS, as well as motocross fans around the world for their passionate support.”

The award formalizes a seven-year framework to triple PAC-3 MSE seeker production.Increased production supports the Pentagon's Acquisition Transformation Strategy and strengthens the nation's U.S. Arsenal of Freedom.HUNTSVILLE, Ala., Oct. 5, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Boeing [NYSE:BA] was awarded an undefinitized contract action worth approximately $14.7 billion by Lockheed Martin [NYSE: LMT] to scale production and deliver PAC-3® Missile Segment Enhancement (MSE) seekers.The contract award enables Boeing to triple PAC-3 MSE seeker production under the previously announced seven-year framework agreement with the U.S. Department of War in support of its Acquisition Transformation Strategy and to strengthen the nation's Arsenal of Freedom.Boeing-built seekers enable the most advanced Patriot interceptors to identify, track and engage advanced threats ranging from hostile aircraft to hypersonic, ballistic and cruise missiles."Early investment and a relentless focus on quality and execution have positioned us to now deliver seekers at unprecedented levels in the near-term, and we're committed to building on that momentum," said Steve Parker, president and CEO of Boeing Defense, Space & Security. "Our Boeing teammates could not be prouder of the role they play in protecting U.S. and allied service members, civilians and critical infrastructure worldwide."In addition to recent capital investments to expand its PAC-3 seeker factory, Boeing has strengthened supplier relationships for a more agile, affordable, resilient and scalable supply chain, modernized facilities with cutting-edge technology, and improved processes and controls to increase first-time quality.Production ramp-up and hiring to support it began earlier this year following the framework agreement announcement, with hundreds of direct and indirect jobs expected to be created in the Huntsville, Alabama, area as a result of the contract.The production increase supports the U.S. Department of War's focus on strengthening the Arsenal of Freedom and aligns with its Acquisition Transformation Strategy to accelerate delivery of key capabilities to service members.A leading global aerospace company and top U.S. exporter, Boeing develops, manufactures and services commercial airplanes, defense products and space systems for customers in more than 150 countries. Our U.S. and global workforce and supplier base drive innovation, economic opportunity, sustainability and community impact. 		Brad McMullen, Boeing Senior Vice President of Commercial Sales and Marketing, and Mesfin Tasew, Group CEO of Ethiopian Airlines, announced the African carrier has ordered eight 777-8 Freighters and two 777 Freighters.
Firm order includes eight 777-8 Freighters and two 777 FreightersFirst African carrier to purchase the world's newest widebody freighter, the 777-8 FreighterEthiopian Airlines doubles its 777X family order bookADDIS ABABA, Ethiopia, Sept. 30, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Boeing (NYSE: BA) and Ethiopian Airlines today announced the African carrier has ordered eight 777-8 Freighters and two 777 Freighters. The airline will pair the proven performance of the 777 Freighter with the next generation 777X capabilities of the new 777-8 Freighter to expand its Boeing freighter fleet.The order is Ethiopian Airlines' second for the 777X airplane family, building on its purchase of eight 777-9 passenger jets that established the carrier as Africa's first 777X customer. The 777-8 Freighter will be the world's largest and most capable twin-engine freighter, supporting Ethiopian Airlines' expanding global network and advancing its international freight operations."This agreement marks another significant milestone in strengthening Ethiopian Airlines' cargo capabilities while supporting the continued expansion of our global network," said Mesfin Tasew, Group CEO of Ethiopian Airlines. "The addition of the Boeing 777-8F Freighters and 777F Freighters will enhance our ability to serve customers around the world with greater payload capacity, operational flexibility, efficiency, and sustainability. As demand for cargo services continues to grow, these aircraft will play a vital role in facilitating global trade, strengthening supply chain connectivity, and further reinforcing Ethiopia's position as a leading cargo gateway between Africa and international markets. It also marks our long-term partnership with Boeing."With a maximum structural payload of 118 tonnes, the 777-8F offers the highest payload and range capability to open new markets while reducing fuel use and delivering the lowest operating cost per tonne of any freighter. The 777F set the standard for twin-engine freighter efficiency and productivity, and Ethiopian Airlines' 777F fleet ranks among the most highly utilized commercial airplanes in service."Ethiopian Airlines' order for the industry-leading 777 Freighter and new 777-8 Freighter highlights both the strength of our partnership and growing demand for air cargo worldwide," said Brad McMullen, Boeing senior vice president of Commercial Sales and Marketing. "We appreciate Ethiopian Airlines' continued confidence in Boeing and the 777 and 777X family of airplanes as it expands its cargo capabilities and global network. The airline continues to make history as the first in Africa to order the new 777-8 Freighter."  The 777-8F will complement Ethiopian Airlines' freighter fleet, retaining the key features of the 777 Freighter that support efficient operations, high utilization and reliability, including common cross-sections and walkways, and easy carriage of large outsize cargo.Ethiopian Airlines currently connects more than 70 cargo markets across Africa, Asia, Europe, the Middle East and North America with a fleet of:12 777 FreightersTwo 767 FreightersAnd four 737-800SF airplanesThe new order will enable the airline to build on this network by providing greater flexibility to meet rising global demand for air cargo.A leading global aerospace company and top U.S. exporter, Boeing develops, manufactures and services commercial airplanes, defense products and space systems for customers in more than 150 countries. Our U.S. and global workforce and supplier base drive innovation, economic opportunity, sustainability and community impact. U.S. Navy receives C-130J-30 Super Hercules to become future TACAMO platform, E-130J Phoenix II
			View File Download File
		Lockheed-Martin-delivered-a-C-130J-30-Super-Hercules-aircraft
MARIETTA, Ga., Oct. 16, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- A new era of strategic airborne command and control capability for the U.S. Navy has officially begun with Lockheed Martin (NYSE:LMT) delivering a C-130J-30 Super Hercules aircraft destined to become the future of the Take Charge and Move Out (TACAMO) mission, at the company's Marietta, Georgia, facility on Oct. 15.
The C-130J-30 Super Hercules will be modified into the E-130J Phoenix II, the Navy's next‑generation TACAMO mission platform, fulfilling an added mission for the Super Hercules. TACAMO is the U.S. Navy's airborne nuclear command‑and‑control support mission.The Super Hercules provides the Navy with a domestically produced, reliable, long-endurance, four-engine platform with the proven performance to successfully carry out the TACAMO mission. With advanced avionics, increased power, greater range, fuel efficiency and payload capacity, the C‑130J‑30 delivers the capabilities and endurance this critical mission demands."This delivery marks a historic milestone for the U.S. Navy, Lockheed Martin, and the nation's strategic communications network," said Trish Pagan, vice president of Lockheed Martin's Air Mobility & Maritime Missions. "The C-130J-30 Super Hercules continues to evolve and adapt to the needs of our customers, carrying the proven reliability of its lineage while transforming into a new, strategic mission set. It is built to deliver the capabilities our joint force demands and built to last through any operational challenge."The delivery re-establishes the link between the TACAMO mission and the Hercules family. For three decades, the EC-130Q variant served as the Navy's TACAMO platform, flying the mission successfully from 1963 until 1993. The new Super Hercules builds on that legacy while adding advanced avionics, communications and survivability enhancements."The C-130J platform has a storied history supporting our strategic communications mission, and accepting this first C-130J-30 marks an exciting new chapter," said U.S. Navy Capt. Roger Davis, Airborne Strategic Command, Control and Communications program manager (PMA-271). "Lockheed Martin's delivery of this battle-proven airframe provides the structural and performance backbone our mission requires as we transition into mission systems integration to field the E-130J Phoenix II."As part of the Super Hercules' transformation, the aircraft will be transferred to Northrop Grumman, the mission systems integrator, where the E-130J TACAMO industry team will complete the conversion that will see the airframe enter service as the E‑130J Phoenix II.About the C-130J Super HerculesThe C-130J Super Hercules is the latest generation of the legendary C-130 Hercules. Built with advanced avionics, increased range and speed, and enhanced survivability, the C-130J is certified across 20 different mission sets — including airdrop, search and rescue, firefighting, medevac, ISR, special operations, among others. It is the only tactical airlifter with a global fleet of more than 570 aircraft and continues to serve as the backbone of air mobility worldwide.For additional information, visit our website: https://www.lockheedmartin.com/en-us/products/c130.html. About Lockheed MartinLockheed Martin is a global defense technology company driving innovation and advancing scientific discovery. WASHINGTON, Oct. 15, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Lockheed Martin Skunk Works® (NYSE: LMT) and The Royal Netherlands Aerospace Centre (NLR) today announced a broadening of their strategic partnership at NL-US Defense Industry Days. What began two years ago as an exploratory Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) has matured into a high-impact collaboration, rapidly transitioning advanced technologies from the research lab into operational solutions that directly support the mission readiness of the Royal Netherlands Air Force.This agreement between the two like-minded organizations highlights the power of combined world-class expertise with global industry leadership to accelerate critical technological breakthroughs. Skunk Works' visionary focus on innovation aligns with NLR's mission of making aerospace technology more sustainable, safer, more efficient, and more effective.Proven results driving future innovationSince the inception of this MOU, the two organizations have successfully navigated complex operational and security environments inherent to confidential high-tech development. By establishing robust joint frameworks, workshops, and specialized working groups, NLR and Skunk Works have bridged distinct organizational cultures. This operational success has unlocked more opportunities, paving the way for a deeper and more ambitious roadmap."We believe that modern aerospace development relies on global integration rather than isolation, making cross-border partnerships essential to deliver systems that no single nation can build alone," said Tineke van der Veen, CEO at Royal NLR. "Referring to the Dutch Defence White Paper 2026, NATO is the cornerstone of our defense, with the United States as our most important ally. Together with Skunk Works, we're committed to cooperate to solve the highest priorities of the air force for the challenges ahead of us.""Lockheed Martin is excited about continued partnership with NLR through expansion of this MOU," said Ron Fehlen, vice president and general manager of Skunk Works. New Hadrian partnership bringing world-class, commercial-style manufacturing technology to accelerate production of critical munitions DALLAS, Oct. 14, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Lockheed Martin (NYSE: LMT) today announced plans to create 6,000 jobs across the United States including 2,000 in Texas, as the company expands advanced manufacturing capacity to accelerate production of critical munitions.At the center of that growth is Lockheed Martin's Grand Prairie operation, where the company is investing $300 million and expanding its manufacturing footprint to more than 735,000 square feet. The expansion includes 100,000 square feet of new space and 85,000 square feet of office space being transformed for advanced manufacturing, creating additional capacity for automation, digital manufacturing and high-precision machining.The company also announced today that Hadrian will bring an innovative, highly automated machining cell to the Grand Prairie facility, operated by the world-class Lockheed Martin production workforce. Expected to be operational in early 2027, the 24-machine cell will bring commercial-style manufacturing technology directly into Lockheed Martin's production environment and add dedicated capacity for critical defense components.THE BIG PICTURELockheed Martin is building a manufacturing model designed for speed, scale and sustained production, bringing together the best of defense and commercial manufacturing to build a more resilient, automated and digitally integrated production model designed to deliver critical capabilities faster. The new Hadrian cell is the latest example of that strategy. It follows Lockheed Martin's recently announced collaboration with GM Defense to apply commercial automotive manufacturing expertise to defense production.EXPERT PERSPECTIVE"This expansion is more than just a new facility; it is a stronger supply chain and a more resilient industrial base," said Michael P. Duffey, Under Secretary of War for Acquisition and Sustainment. "Today in Grand Prairie, American industry is answering the call to support our warfighters.""Lockheed Martin has brought together commercial speed and combat-proven performance because America needs both," said Jim Taiclet, chairman, president and CEO of Lockheed Martin. "By combining advanced technology with the expertise of our American workforce, we're transforming manufacturing to deliver critical munitions at speed and scale.""The warfighter can't wait on peacetime timelines. Hadrian is bringing the automation, software and workforce training from our own factories directly inside Lockheed Martin, so we can produce more, faster. Rebuilding the Arsenal of Freedom at the scale America needs will take partnerships that combine expertise and speed, and this is what that looks like," said Chris Power, CEO of Hadrian.WHY IT MATTERSDelivering critical munitions: Lockheed Martin's Grand Prairie facility supports all Missiles and Fire Control programs, including PAC-3 MSE, THAAD, PrSM and JATM. The expansion and partnership announced today will help Grand Prairie reach record production levels and deliver components to final-assembly sites including Camden, Arkansas, and Troy, Alabama.Investing ahead of demand: The $300 million investment in this expansion is part of the company's broader commitment to invest $8–9 billion through 2030 to scale munitions production and modernize or expand more than 20 facilities across the United States.Building a manufacturing model that can scale: Lockheed Martin is combining a highly skilled workforce with automation, digital manufacturing, precision machining and commercial manufacturing practices to increase capacity and strengthen the defense industrial base.Creating greater predictability: Working with Department of War leadership, Lockheed Martin is applying commercially inspired contracting approaches through landmark agreements for PAC-3 MSE, THAAD, PrSM and JATM. These agreements provide greater predictability to invest in people, equipment and supply chains while accelerating production and delivery.ADDITIONAL CONTEXTThe Grand Prairie facility is already home to hundreds of critical machining and advanced manufacturing assets, and Lockheed Martin is rapidly adding even more capacity. In just a few months, the company has transformed former office space into advanced manufacturing areas and installed more than 30 additional high-precision machines now producing thousands of critical components each week.By the end of 2026, Lockheed Martin expects to have added nearly 100 new advanced machines across the facility.Nearly 800 production employees currently work at the facility which manufactured 250,000 parts in 2025.Today's announcement with Hadrian follows the signing of a seven-year agreement signed by both companies in 2025.  About Lockheed MartinLockheed Martin is a global defense technology company driving innovation and advancing scientific discovery. Our all-domain mission solutions and 21st Century Security® vision accelerate the delivery of transformative technologies to ensure those we serve always stay ahead of ready. More information at Lockheedmartin.com. About HadrianHadrian is rebuilding America's industrial base with highly automated factories that combine process engineering, AI, and robotics. Its mission is to help space and defense manufacturers produce full programs at scale in the U.S. while giving American workers the tools to compete globally.The company operates four facilities covering just under 3 million square feet: two in Torrance, California, and newly launched sites in Arizona and Alabama, with additional sites in development across the country. More information at https://www.hadrian.co/. SOURCE Lockheed Martin

SAP Puts the Autonomous Enterprise to Work
        Press Release
        by SAP News
October 6, 2026
Joule Work, Joule Assistants and SAP Business AI Platform help organizations turn business AI into trusted outcomes across every core function.
LAS VEGAS — SAP SE (NYSE: SAP) today showcased the Autonomous Enterprise in action at SAP Connect, demonstrating how Joule Work and Joule Assistants generate value for customers across every line of business.
“This is a breakthrough moment for business AI,” said Christian Klein, CEO of SAP SE. “The Autonomous Enterprise has arrived. With Joule and SAP Autonomous Suite, built on SAP Business AI Platform, we’re helping organizations like Novartis, Morgan Foods, Nestlé and PwC connect intelligence across every function to deliver trusted business outcomes.”
SAP Connect in 2026: Advancing the Autonomous Enterprise
Read the innovation news guide
At SAP Connect, these customers shared how the Autonomous Enterprise is already driving measurable value across their businesses:
“We’ve co-developed and recently launched a pilot of SAP’s Joule Sourcing Assistant,” said Christoph Buerki, Head of Procurement, Novartis. “Our vision is for AI agents to handle the manual heavy lifting, enabling sourcing professionals to focus on strategy, supplier engagement and value creation.”
“At Morgan Foods, we’re already putting the pieces in place for agentic adoption, especially through our technical foundation. The biggest shift will be moving from reactive to predictive, where agents can connect demand signals, inventory levels and supplier status faster than ever before,” said Steve Hankins, Chief Financial Officer, Morgan Foods, “Our superpower will come from people on top of agents. Our approximately 1,000 employees are what make our supply chains work—the technology helps make them even better.”
“Our SAP S/4HANA transformation across 140 countries is creating a connected digital core with consistent processes, trusted data and greater visibility across markets and functions. With that foundation, Joule and the Accounts Receivable Assistant can automatically prioritize collections work based on risk and business context, recommend the next best action and help our finance teams respond faster to change,” said Luca Dell’Orletta, Global Head IT Innovation & Enterprise Architecture, Nestlé.
“In professional services, billing can be one of the more error-prone processes, with accuracy playing an important role in the client experience. SAP’s Billing Assistant brings greater intelligence to this critical process, helping identify potential issues earlier so our people can deliver better client outcomes and build stronger relationships,” said Jill Notz, Chief Accounting Officer, Controller, Business Services Leader, PwC. Building on the success of the Billing Assistant, PwC and SAP are extending their collaboration into new areas of joint AI innovation.
SAP’s Autonomous Enterprise Scales Up
Joule Work is beginning its customer rollout as a new AI user interface that lets employees interact with SAP solutions in their own language and complete work across SAP and third-party data. Grounded in business context from SAP Knowledge Graph, which maps more than 7 million data fields, Joule provides information users can rely on. At SAP, Joule Work is already live with 110,000 employees, with the company seeing 20% productivity gains across finance, HR and procurement. A select group of customers also is using Joule Work in their business environments.
“Partnering within the Early Adopter Program for Joule Work Desktop has delivered more momentum in just a few months than we saw in all the years before,” said Peter Wied, Director of Complexity Management at Reinhausen. “We see huge potential in making access to our SAP S/4HANA data significantly easier and faster through natural language. This has the potential to permanently transform how our teams interact with business data.”
“The dedicated team has been phenomenal. Their proactive communication, focus on accelerating architecture activation, rapid remediation of defects and overall support have enabled us to become Joule ready much sooner than would have been possible had we needed to navigate these challenges on our own,” said Keith Smith, SAP Platform Architect, CONA Services. “The CONA team is excited about the progress made to date and looks forward to exploring and testing Joule’s capabilities in greater depth over the coming months as we continue our adoption journey.”
When a query is not enough, Joule Assistants execute operational work directly within business workflows, using established data, authorizations and audit trails. Customers control the level of autonomy. SAP’s approach is also open: through the Agent2Agent protocol, Joule can connect with third-party AI and agents, bringing governed business context into broader AI workflows.
At SAP Connect, SAP showcased how these capabilities generate outcomes across SAP Autonomous Suite:
In finance, controllers can automate revenue recognition, disclosures and trade compliance, with early deployments of the International Trade Assistant reducing trade classification effort by up to 50%.
In supply chain, planners can turn multi-hour disruptions into one-click resolutions across planning, manufacturing and logistics.
In HR, leaders can determine the best way to close workforce gaps, while employees can make smarter benefits choices tailored to their needs.
In procurement, decision-makers can identify savings opportunities against peer benchmarks and manage the full contingent workforce life cycle.
In customer experience, organizations can turn customer engagement into sales opportunities with AI-powered campaigns, quoting and customer workflows.
Across industries, SAP is collaborating with customers to apply AI to specialized industry processes, helping organizations in manufacturing, retail, commodity trading and asset-intensive industries improve decision-making, automate routine actions and build more resilient operations.
The Platform Powering Business AI You Can Trust
SAP Business AI Platform gives organizations one place to build, contextualize and govern AI across SAP and third-party environments. With Joule Studio, business users and developers can build and extend skills and agents from no-code to pro-code workflows, choosing from more than 70 AI models. SAP Business Data Cloud and SAP Knowledge Graph ground those agents in trusted business data and context, helping organizations select the right model for each use case and better manage AI value and consumption.
SAP-managed governance helps organizations scale AI with transparency, accountability and control. SAP AI Agent Hub in SAP LeanIX solutions provides a central inventory of enterprise agents, while SAP’s independently ISO/IEC 42001-certified governance architecture supports regulatory requirements, established authorizations and auditable AI operations.
To help organizations adopt AI at scale, SAP’s Business Transformation Management portfolio, including SAP Signavio, SAP LeanIX and SAP WalkMe solutions, provides the toolchain to analyze processes, govern applications and agents, and drive adoption across the enterprise.
SAP Brings Embedded Payments to Cloud ERP
SAP also announced that it is entering the payments market with SAP Pay, powered by Tereina, an SAP company. Embedded directly in SAP Cloud ERP, SAP Pay executes and reconciles payments within the same workflow when an invoice is due, reducing manual file handling and external processing dependencies, while giving customers greater control.
Partners Expand the Reach of Autonomous Business
SAP is extending the Autonomous Enterprise beyond SAP’s own application portfolio through new partnerships that bring specialized intelligence directly into SAP workflows.
A new partnership between SAP and Moody’s Corporation is designed to embed Moody’s supplier risk monitoring data into SAP Ariba Supplier Lifecycle and Performance. This gives procurement teams continuously updated insights into supplier financial health, operational risk and regulatory status at the point of decision. Organizations will be able to move from periodic risk reviews toward continuous monitoring, enabling Joule Agents to flag supplier risk signals and surface alternatives before disruption affects the business.
An expanded partnership with ORO Labs brings procurement orchestration to SAP customers as a solution extension. SAP Ariba Procurement Orchestration by ORO Labs is a purpose-built orchestration layer that connects procurement workflows end to end across heterogeneous enterprise environments, giving business users a seamless experience for intake, actions and visibility.

SAP to Acquire TechWolf, Giving Enterprises Evidence-Based View of Work in the Age of AI
        Press Release
        by SAP News
October 6, 2026
WALLDORF and GHENT, Belgium — SAP SE (NYSE: SAP) and TechWolf today announced they have entered into an agreement for SAP to acquire TechWolf, provider of a leading AI work intelligence platform.
Automate end-to-end processes, drive context-aware decisions and optimize workforce operations at scale
Learn how
TechWolf gives enterprises a continuously updated view of the work their people do and the skills they have, using its proprietary data model called context graph for work. The acquisition will bring this context graph, along with TechWolf’s AI models and applied AI research team, into SAP, establishing work intelligence as a strategic SAP asset. The deal is expected to close in Q4 2026, subject to usual closing conditions, including regulatory approval. Terms of the deal were not disclosed.
TechWolf works from existing HR and business systems that customers connect. It builds its model of the organization at three levels: the work itself, down to the tasks inside a job; the skills people have and apply; and the external labor market. It maps that against the customer’s business strategy, so the leaders responsible for hiring, reskilling and redeployment are working from better information.
TechWolf is expected to become an intelligent core of the SAP SuccessFactors portfolio, supporting the company’s talent and work intelligence strategy. TechWolf will power workforce and talent strategies across SAP SuccessFactors, bringing skills mapping, workforce planning and organizational redesign informed by context from across the Autonomous Enterprise. Once the transaction closes, TechWolf and SAP will unify skills and work data to inform HR and business leaders to guide decisions about development, deployment and workforce transformation.
“TechWolf’s proprietary context graph for skills and work provides an excellent grounding layer for agent queries regarding work and skills planning and talent management,” said Manoj Swaminathan, president and chief product officer for SAP Autonomous Suite and member of the Extended Board of SAP SE. “This grounding layer perfectly matches our strategy. It makes token usage more efficient, lowers the cost of deploying workforce agents and will make Joule more intelligent in AI-driven HR scenarios such as skills-based hiring, workforce planning and role redesign.”
Joint SAP and TechWolf customers using the technology are seeing measurable results from the partnership the two companies have had. Building on that foundation, SAP and TechWolf will jointly co-innovate a concrete set of new AI-powered workforce and skills optimization products to be designed and developed post-close. SAP plans to integrate TechWolf’s solutions to a greater degree, offering customers even better insights and work intelligence to help organizations plan reskilling, internal mobility and hiring.
“Organizations everywhere are trying to figure out how AI is reshaping work, and what their workforce needs to look like because of it,” said Andreas De Neve, CEO and co-founder of TechWolf. “We have spent eight years building the evidence layer to answer those questions. It’s always been our mission to connect skills, tasks and work to help employers solve AI transformation, and joining SAP will allow us to extend that mission across a broader set of business context and larger scale. In this next chapter, we plan to build a world-class AI company.”
Subject to closing and required consultation, SAP’s current plans are for TechWolf to remain as an independent entity under CEO Andreas De Neve in its Ghent headquarters, with offices in London, New York and San Francisco, and for its platform to remain available to both SAP and non-SAP customers. J.P. Morgan served as exclusive financial advisor to TechWolf.

TechWolf is a leading applied AI company that helps large enterprises understand how AI is transforming work and what that means for their workforce. Customers include HSBC, Atlas Copco Group, GSK, Ericsson, AMD, MetLife, PayPal and Booking.com. TabPFN-3.5 Plus Now Available in SAP AI Core for Instant Business Predictions
        Newsbyte
        by SAP News
September 15, 2026
WALLDORF — SAP SE (NYSE: SAP) today announced availability of the new TabPFN-3.5 model from Prior Labs, an SAP company.
Capture business-wide AI value with speed and confidence
Learn more
This model marks the next leap in tabular AI, giving organizations access to unmatched tabular AI predictions on structured business data without model training or tuning. For SAP customers, TabPFN-3.5 Plus is now available in SAP AI Core.
Critical enterprise business decisions, such as cash flow forecasting, payment delays or supplier risk scoring, run on structured, tabular data. While LLMs excel at language and knowledge, tabular foundation models (TFMs) are purpose-built for structured data and can accurately predict business outcomes based on tabular data such as payment delays, supplier risks, upsell opportunities, customer churn risk and more.
With TabPFN-3.5, SAP customers can work with data as it exists in their systems. Missing values, mixed data types and inconsistent fields are handled by the model, returning accurate predictions without preprocessing. This newest model from Prior Labs’ family of tabular AI models uses in-context learning to make predictions from raw tabular data, handling columns with thousands of distinct values, such as product codes or customer identifiers, and mixed data types natively, without the trial-and-error configuration that traditional models require. TabPFN-3.5 Plus is the most accurate and scalable tabular foundation model available today, based on TabArena and BeyondArena, two external benchmarks designed to evaluate predictions over real-world data.
“Real-world data is rarely perfect. Datasets often contain complex relationships and varying conditions that make traditional machine learning difficult. TabPFN-3.5 is specifically built for these challenges, providing industry-leading accuracy and scalability for tabular data with less manual effort—making it the most effective tabular AI model in the industry to date,” said Philipp Herzig, Chief Technology Officer, SAP SE. “With TabPFN-3.5 and the SAP-RPT model family, customers get accurate predictions from labeled business data in minutes, with no training required. For us, tabular AI is not a supporting feature of the Autonomous Enterprise, it is the foundation.”
For more detailed information and to learn how to get started on SAP AI Core, see the SAP Community blog, and view the TabPFN-3.5 Technical Report.
SAP completed its acquisition of Prior Labs in July 2026, bringing one of the world’s leading TFM research teams into the SAP family. Prior Labs will continue to operate as an independent entity, with SAP having previously committed to invest more than €1 billion to scale it into a globally leading frontier AI lab for the structured data that underpins the world’s businesses.

                        GE Vernova
                      Net Zero Without Compromising Reliability: GE Vernova Shows How Spain Can Design a Power System That Achieves Both
                                                                     6 min read
                                        Spain has proven renewables can scale, now it must ensure the system can operate reliably as complexity increases
                                        Net zero is achievable, but not all pathways are equal, system design choices will determine cost, resilience, and long-term performance
                                        Electricity demand is expected to grow ~60% by 2050, increasing pressure on flexibility, grid infrastructure, and system coordination
                                        New analysis from GE Vernova outlines the trade-offs and system choices required to deliver a reliable net zero power system
MADRID, SPAIN (15 October 2026) – Spain has emerged as one of Europe’s leading renewable energy markets, with renewables supplying nearly 57% of electricity in 2025 and more than 80% renewable electricity expected by 2030. But as renewable penetration accelerates and electricity demand is projected to grow by around 60% by 2050, the country’s next challenge is no longer scaling renewable energy, it is ensuring the power system can operate reliably under increasing complexity.As renewable penetration rises and system dynamics shift, challenges around stability, flexibility, and grid coordination are becoming more pronounced. Events such as the April 2025 Iberian blackout have brought renewed attention to system strength, reserve margins, and the need for coordinated grid operation in a high-renewables environment.New analysis from GE Vernova examines how Spain can meet its net zero goals while maintaining reliability, affordability, and system resilience.The analysis finds that Spain can achieve a net zero electricity system by 2050 through multiple pathways. documents.title: GE Vernova to Double the Number of MIT Interns and Permanent Hires in 2027
documents.raw_text:
press release
                        GE Vernova
                      GE Vernova to Double the Number of MIT Interns and Permanent Hires in 2027
                                                                     5 min read
                                        Will build on robust 2026 effort to recruit and develop the next generation of energy innovators
CAMBRIDGE, Mass. – October 6, 2026 – GE Vernova (NYSE: GEV) today announced its goal to double the number of MIT interns and permanent hires it brings on board in 2027, a meaningful expansion of its Alliance with the Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) that underscores GE Vernova’s commitment to building the workforce of the future. The announcement was made at the MIT x GE Vernova Alliance Fall Fair, held today at Hockfield Court on the MIT campus.“Among the students on campuses today are the engineers, innovators and future leaders who will define the next era of energy, and our job is to give more of them the opportunity to join us, grow with us, and change the world,” said Scott Strazik, CEO of GE Vernova. "MIT is one of our most important partners in that effort, and what we're building together isn't incremental – we are doubling down. We are working together to identify the very best talent and enable them to make a real impact."The event today brings together MIT students, faculty, and GE Vernova leaders and engineers to showcase the company's research collaborations, career opportunities, and technology innovation. This year's event features 12 Alliance Year Two research poster presentations, live technology demonstrations including robotics, large voltage monitoring detection, and frontal polymerization research, and a recruiting zone staffed to support interest in 2027 internship opportunities.GE Vernova and MIT are in the second year of their Energy and Climate Alliance, a $50 million, five-year commitment spanning breakthrough research across the entire energy ecosystem: from generating electrons to moving them around the world efficiently. Beyond research, the Alliance is designed to develop the energy sector's future workforce through fellowships, internships, and a dedicated career exploration program connecting MIT students and faculty with opportunities across GE Vernova's global teams. In 2026 the company welcomed 80 MIT interns and permanent hires.  "The energy transition will require a generation of talent that is deeply technical, globally minded, and ready to solve problems at scale," said Steven Baert, Chief People Officer of GE Vernova. "Doubling our MIT intern and hiring numbers in a single year isn't something we're doing lightly, it's a signal of how seriously we take investing in talent early, and our commitment to building career pathways that give the best and brightest a place to do the most meaningful work of their careers."GE Vernova recruits from a wide range of universities and engineering programs across the United States and globally as part of its broader talent and workforce development strategy.Today's announcement reflects an urgent workforce reality outlined in GE Vernova's inaugural NextGen Workforce Study: the U.S. energy sector could need more than two million workers by 2032. To meet the massive growth in electricity demand driven by AI, data centers, and the industrial electrification surge, the study finds the industry will need one in every ten engineering graduates to join the power sector. GE Vernova's expanded MIT commitment is part of a broader effort to make those pathways visible and accessible earlier.For more information about the GE Vernova and MIT Alliance, visit here. For more information about GE Vernova's Internship programs, visit here.
                                end

Pennsylvania Gov. Josh Shapiro joined Merck executive leadership, federal and state government officials and local community partners for a ribbon-cutting ceremony to celebrate the pivotal expansion of the company’s premier research and development capabilities.
By integrating highly automated robotic systems and advanced digital AI capabilities, ADVANCE is designed to streamline the analysis of biological samples from Merck’s ongoing clinical development programs while supporting one of the broadest and most diverse pipelines in the company’s recent history.
“My Administration has made life sciences a key part of our economic development strategy here in Pennsylvania — and Merck’s major investment in Montgomery County is another major win for the Commonwealth,” said Gov. Josh Shapiro. “We are proud to partner with Merck as they expand their operations in Montgomery County, advance cutting-edge research and manufacturing, and create new opportunities for thousands of Pennsylvanians. The life sciences industry is booming in Pennsylvania and I am committed to winning more investments like this and making sure our Commonwealth remains a national leader in innovation, medicine and manufacturing.”
The ribbon-cutting marks another significant milestone for the 400-acre West Point campus, Merck’s largest integrated research and human health manufacturing site. Since 1953, West Point site has been home to a series of important biopharmaceutical breakthroughs. The addition of the ADVANCE research facility ensures Pennsylvania remains a key driver of global scientific innovation.
“The ADVANCE facility represents the future of clinical development at Merck and underscores our continued commitment to addressing the needs of the patients we serve,” said Rob Davis, chairman and chief executive officer, Merck. “This builds on our longstanding presence in Pennsylvania where we’re proud to invest in the people, communities and scientific capabilities that will help drive the next generation of medicines.”
A legacy of scientific progress in Pennsylvania
Merck originally acquired the West Point site as part of the landmark 1953 merger of Merck and Sharp & Dohme. Since then, Merck’s operations in Pennsylvania have grown substantially, transforming the West Point campus into a cornerstone of the company’s research efforts and global manufacturing supply chain. Today, the site is the largest employer in Montgomery County, Pennsylvania, and the seventh largest private employer in the state.
Merck has made significant capital investments to the West Point site totaling more than $15 billion over the past 35 years. As part of the company’s previously announced $70 billion commitment to domestic manufacturing and R&D, Merck is investing approximately $550 million in R&D facilities at ADVANCE and the nearby Spring House Innovation Park (SHIP).
The capital investments at West Point have continuously sustained an on-site workforce of approximately 800 contracting, engineering, and construction jobs during this time. Many of these capital projects have been designed in Pennsylvania and represent more than $1 billion in services provided by locally based architects.
About Merck
At Merck, known as MSD outside of the United States and Canada, we are unified around our purpose: We use the power of leading-edge science to save and improve lives around the world. For more than 130 years, we have brought hope to humanity through the development of important medicines and vaccines. We aspire to be the premier research-intensive biopharmaceutical company in the world – and today, we are at the forefront of research to deliver innovative health solutions that advance the prevention and treatment of diseases in people and animals. We foster an inclusive global workforce and operate responsibly every day to enable a safe, sustainable and healthy future for all people and communities. For more information, visit www.merck.com and connect with us on X (formerly Twitter), Facebook, Instagram, YouTube and LinkedIn.

INTerpath-001 data to be presented in Presidential Symposium, featuring the first Phase 3 results for investigational intismeran autogene plus KEYTRUDA® (pembrolizumab), demonstrating improvements in recurrence-free survival and distant metastasis-free survival versus KEYTRUDA alone in patients with completely resected stage IIB-IV melanoma in the adjuvant setting
Investigational sacituzumab tirumotecan (sac-TMT) data from TroFuse-005, the first and only Phase 3 trial of a TROP2-directed antibody-drug conjugate to improve overall survival and progression-free survival in certain patients with advanced or recurrent endometrial cancer, will be presented in a Presidential Symposium
KEYNOTE-C93 data to be presented in Presidential Symposium suggesting important role of first-line KEYTRUDA monotherapy for certain patients with mismatch repair deficient (dMMR) advanced or recurrent endometrial cancer
 RAHWAY, N.J.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--
Merck (NYSE: MRK), known as MSD outside of the United States and Canada, today announced that first-time results from three pivotal clinical trials will be presented during late-breaking Presidential Symposia at the European Society for Medical Oncology (ESMO) Congress 2026 in Madrid, Spain from Oct. 23-27. Additionally, more than 90 additional abstracts across more than 20 tumor types from the company’s pipeline and portfolio will be presented throughout the meeting.“New data at ESMO, including three Presidential Symposia from three pivotal trials, reflect the strength and depth of Merck’s industry-leading oncology portfolio and pipeline,” said Dr. Marjorie Green, senior vice president and head of oncology global clinical development, Merck Research Laboratories. "We are proud to share Phase 3 data for the first time from intismeran and sac-TMT, alongside new research from our oncology portfolio, reflecting our commitment to advancing research across a range of cancer types."Key data from Merck’s pipeline and portfolio to be presented:First presentation of data from the pivotal Phase 3 INTerpath-001 trial evaluating intismeran autogene (intismeran; V940/mRNA-4157), a novel investigational mRNA-based individualized neoantigen therapy, in combination with KEYTRUDA ®(pembrolizumab), Merck’s anti-PD-1 therapy, as adjuvant treatment for patients with completely resected stage IIB-IV melanoma, which will be featured in an ESMO Presidential Symposium (Presentation #LBA1, Proffered paper session: Presidential Symposium I). 1First presentation of data Ltd and Astex Pharmaceuticals (UK), a wholly owned subsidiary of Otsuka Pharmaceutical Co., LtdAbout intismeran autogeneIntismeran autogene (intismeran; V940 or mRNA-4157) is a novel, potential first-in-class investigational messenger RNA (mRNA)-based individualized neoantigen therapy (INT) jointly developed by Merck and Moderna. Intismeran is designed and produced using a patient's tumor sample to identify the unique mutational signature, or "fingerprint," of their cancer and generate an anti-tumor immune response. Each therapy consists of a synthetic mRNA coding for up to 34 neoantigens and is tailored to the unique biology of an individual patient's tumor. Upon administration, the RNA-encoded neoantigen sequences are translated in the body and presented to the immune system, a key step in generating specific T-cell responses against cancer cells. Individualized neoantigen therapies are designed to train and activate an anti-tumor immune response based on the unique mutational signature of a patient's tumor. Merck and Moderna are advancing the robust INTerpath clinical development program evaluating the safety and efficacy of intismeran in combination with KEYTRUDA and other anti-cancer therapies, and as a monotherapy.About sacituzumab tirumotecan (sac-TMT)Sac-TMT is an investigational TROP2-directed ADC with a belotecan-derived topoisomerase I inhibitor payload and a unique bifunctional linker designed with the potential to maximize payload delivery to tumor cells and minimize payload loss while circulating in the body.TROP2 is overexpressed on tumor cells compared to healthy cells in many common cancers, and through the TroFuse clinical development program, Merck is evaluating sac-TMT in 18 ongoing global Phase 3 trials across multiple tumor types, the broadest range of disease and treatment settings compared to any TROP2-directed ADC to date. The TroFuse development program spans early-to-late-stage disease in more than nine disease areas and includes more than 15,000 patients worldwide. Numerous Phase 3 trials are exploring sac-TMT as monotherapy and in combination with immunotherapies, aiming to improve survival and quality of life for patients with advanced and earlier-stage cancers.About calderasibCalderasib (MK-1084) is an investigational, highly potent and specific next-generation KRAS G12C covalent inhibitor. Mutations in KRAS are among the most prevalent mutations found in cancer, occurring with high frequency in non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC), pancreatic, urogenital and colorectal cancers. The KRAS G12C mutation is the most frequently observed KRAS mutation in patients, occurring in approximately 14% of patients with NSCLC (adenocarcinoma). Despite decades of research and recognition of the therapeutic importance of targeting KRAS, the development of small molecule inhibitors targeting KRAS mutations has been challenging.About KEYTRUDA® (pembrolizumab) injection for intravenous use, 100 mgKEYTRUDA is an anti-programmed death receptor-1 (PD-1) therapy that works by increasing the ability of the body’s immune system to help detect and fight tumor cells. KEYTRUDA is a humanized monoclonal antibody that blocks the interaction between PD-1 and its ligands, PD-L1 and PD-L2, thereby activating T lymphocytes which may affect both tumor cells and healthy cells.Merck has the industry’s largest immuno-oncology clinical research program. There are currently more than 2,800 trials studying KEYTRUDA across a wide variety of cancers and treatment settings. The KEYTRUDA clinical program seeks to understand the role of KEYTRUDA across cancers and the factors that may predict a patient's likelihood of benefitting from treatment with KEYTRUDA, including exploring several different biomarkers.Selected Indications in the U.S. for KEYTRUDA® (pembrolizumab)MelanomaKEYTRUDA is indicated for the treatment of patients with unresectable or metastatic melanoma.KEYTRUDA is indicated for the adjuvant treatment of adult and pediatric (12 years and older) patients with Stage IIB, IIC, or III melanoma following complete resection.Non-Small Cell Lung CancerKEYTRUDA, in combination with pemetrexed and platinum chemotherapy, is indicated for the first-line treatment of patients with metastatic nonsquamous non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC), with no EGFR or ALK genomic tumor aberrations.KEYTRUDA, in combination with carboplatin and either paclitaxel or paclitaxel protein-bound, is indicated for the first-line treatment of patients with metastatic squamous NSCLC.KEYTRUDA, as a single agent, is indicated for the first-line treatment of patients with NSCLC expressing PD-L1 [Tumor Proportion Score (TPS) ≥1%] as determined by an FDA-authorized test, with no EGFR or ALK genomic tumor aberrations, and is:Stage III where patients are not candidates for surgical resection or definitive chemoradiation, ormetastatic.KEYTRUDA, as a single agent, is indicated for the treatment of patients with metastatic NSCLC whose tumors express PD-L1 (TPS ≥1%) as determined by an FDA-authorized test, with disease progression on or after platinum-containing chemotherapy. Patients with EGFR or ALK genomic tumor aberrations should have disease progression on FDA-approved therapy for these aberrations prior to receiving KEYTRUDA.KEYTRUDA is indicated for the treatment of patients with resectable (tumors ≥4 cm or node positive) NSCLC in combination with platinum-containing chemotherapy as neoadjuvant treatment, and then continued as a single agent as adjuvant treatment after surgery.KEYTRUDA, as a single agent, is indicated as adjuvant treatment following resection and platinum-based chemotherapy for adult patients with Stage IB (T2a ≥4 cm), II, or IIIA NSCLC.Head and Neck Squamous Cell CancerKEYTRUDA is indicated for the treatment of adult patients with resectable locally advanced head and neck squamous cell carcinoma (HNSCC) whose tumors express PD-L1 [Combined Positive Score (CPS) ≥1] as determined by an FDA-authorized test, as a single agent as neoadjuvant treatment, continued as adjuvant treatment in combination with radiotherapy (RT) with or without cisplatin and then as a single agent.KEYTRUDA, in combination with platinum and fluorouracil (FU), is indicated for the first-line treatment of patients with metastatic or with unresectable, recurrent HNSCC.KEYTRUDA, as a single agent, is indicated for the first-line treatment of patients with metastatic or with unresectable, recurrent HNSCC whose tumors express PD-L1 (CPS ≥1) as determined by an FDA-authorized test.KEYTRUDA, as a single agent, is indicated for the treatment of patients with recurrent or metastatic HNSCC with disease progression on or after platinum-containing chemotherapy.Urothelial CancerKEYTRUDA, in combination with enfortumab vedotin-ejfv, is indicated for the treatment of adult patients with locally advanced or metastatic urothelial cancer.KEYTRUDA, as a single agent, is indicated for the treatment of patients with locally advanced or metastatic urothelial carcinoma:who are not eligible for any platinum-containing chemotherapy, orwho have disease progression during or following platinum-containing chemotherapy or within 12 months of neoadjuvant or adjuvant treatment with platinum-containing chemotherapy.KEYTRUDA, in combination with enfortumab vedotin-ejfv, as neoadjuvant treatment and then continued after cystectomy as adjuvant treatment, is indicated for the treatment of adult patients with muscle invasive bladder cancer (MIBC).KEYTRUDA, as a single agent, is indicated for the treatment of patients with Bacillus Calmette-Guerin (BCG)-unresponsive, high-risk, non-muscle invasive bladder cancer (NMIBC) with carcinoma in situ (CIS) with Information.Selected Safety Information for KEYTRUDASevere and Fatal Immune-Mediated Adverse ReactionsKEYTRUDA is a monoclonal antibody that belongs to a class of drugs that bind to either the programmed death receptor-1 (PD-1) or the programmed death ligand 1 (PD-L1), blocking the PD-1/PD-L1 pathway, thereby removing inhibition of the immune response, potentially breaking peripheral tolerance and inducing immune-mediated adverse reactions. Immune-mediated adverse reactions, which may be severe or fatal, can occur in any organ system or tissue, can affect more than one body system simultaneously, and can occur at any time after starting treatment or after discontinuation of treatment. Important immune-mediated adverse reactions listed here may not include all possible severe and fatal immune-mediated adverse reactions.Monitor patients closely for symptoms and signs that may be clinical manifestations of underlying immune-mediated adverse reactions. Early identification and management are essential to ensure safe use of anti–PD-1/PD-L1 treatments. Evaluate liver enzymes, creatinine, and thyroid function at baseline and periodically during treatment. For patients with TNBC treated with KEYTRUDA in the neoadjuvant setting, monitor blood cortisol at baseline, prior to surgery, and as clinically indicated. In cases of suspected immune-mediated adverse reactions, initiate appropriate workup to exclude alternative etiologies, including infection. Institute medical management promptly, including specialty consultation as appropriate.Withhold or permanently discontinue KEYTRUDA depending on severity of the immune-mediated adverse reaction. In general, if KEYTRUDA requires interruption or discontinuation, administer systemic corticosteroid therapy (1 to 2 mg/kg/day prednisone or equivalent) until improvement to Grade 1 or less.
